But he's my friend!!
entries.translation:
Ele pode não significar nada para você,
Sábio Tarado... Mas é meu amigo!!

entries.source: Does a friend hurt his comrades!?

What happened was destined to
happen... Dismiss him from your mind,
and move on.
entries.translation:
O que aconteceu estava destinado
a acontecer... Tire-o da cabeça
e siga em frente.

entries.source:
To be a shinobi, you need more than
strength and jutsu.
entries.translation:
Para ser um shinobi, precisa de mais
que força e jutsus.

entries.source:
You need judgment to make the right
decisions... You must become smarter.
entries.translation:
Precisa de bom senso para tomar as
decisões certas... Seja mais esperto.

entries.source:
The longer you remain a fool, the
harder it will be for you to survive.
entries.translation:
Quanto mais tempo for um tolo,
mais difícil será sobreviver.

entries.source:
If that's what being smarter means,
I'll remain a fool my entire life!!
entries.translation:
Se é isso que significa ser esperto,
serei um tolo pelo resto da vida!!

entries.source:
I don't care. I'll create even more
amazing jutsu, so I can bring Sasuke
back!!
entries.translation:
Não me importa. Vou criar jutsus
ainda mais incríveis para trazer
Sasuke de volta!!

entries.source:
The thought of my leaving you to
come up with jutsu on your own...
entries.translation:
Só de pensar em deixar você
inventar jutsus sozinho...

entries.source:
The best you'd come up with is
another one of your goofy sexy
jutsu numbers...
entries.translation:
O máximo que conseguiria seria
mais um daqueles seus
jutsus sensuais idiotas...

entries.source:
This is more than foolish.
It's so colossally foolish it might
even work.
entries.translation:
Isso vai além da tolice.
É tão absurdamente tolo que
talvez até funcione.

entries.source: I hope you're ready for some serious training.
entries.translation: Espero que esteja pronto para um treino sério.

entries.source: If that's what being smarter means...
entries.translation: Se é isso que significa ser esperto...

entries.source: I'll remain a fool my entire life!!
entries.translation: Serei um tolo pelo resto da vida!!

entries.source:
I see...
Sounds like it may be a long trip.
entries.translation:
Entendo...
Parece que será uma longa viagem.

entries.source: I have to go, Iruka sensei!
Next time I'll spring for the ramen!!
entries.translation: Na próxima, o lámen é por minha conta!!

entries.source: What are you doing? Hurry up.
We won't be back for a while, you know.
entries.translation: Vamos ficar bastante tempo fora, sabia?

entries.source:
If I get hung up on the past
I'll never get anywhere.
entries.translation:
Se eu ficar preso ao passado,
nunca vou chegar a lugar nenhum.

entries.source:
Best to look straight ahead,
and keep moving forward.
entries.translation:
É melhor olhar para a frente
e continuar seguindo.

entries.source: I think I left a window open back home!
entries.translation: Acho que deixei uma janela aberta em casa!

entries.source:
Hah... You have to pay attention to
the details, kid.
entries.translation:
Ah... Precisa prestar atenção
nos detalhes, garoto.

entries.source:
I only forgot 'cause you
rushed me, Pervy Sage...
entries.translation:
Só esqueci porque você
me apressou, Sábio Tarado...

entries.source:
Oh that's nice...
Blame your teacher, why don't you!
entries.translation:
Ah, que bonito...
Culpe seu professor, por que não?!
Uma nova missão de nível D está disponível!
Uma nova missão de nível C está disponível!
Uma nova missão de nível B está disponível!
Uma nova missão de nível A está disponível!
Uma nova missão de nível S está disponível!

entries.source:
That's strange. I haven't received the
flowers I ordered from Yamanaka Flower
Shop.
entries.translation:
Que estranho. Ainda não recebi as
flores que encomendei na
Floricultura Yamanaka.

entries.source:
The girl at the shop said she'd send
them right away, but…
entries.translation:
A moça da loja disse que
enviaria na mesma hora, mas…

entries.source: There's not much time... Will they get here?
entries.translation: Falta pouco tempo... Será que vão chegar?

entries.source:
I never expected such a rare insect to be
discovered...
entries.translation:
Nunca imaginei que descobririam
um inseto tão raro...

entries.source:
Shino. I'm counting on you. You must
capture it!
entries.translation:
Shino. Conto com você.
Precisa capturá-lo!

entries.source:
He-he... I feel excited to be on the hunt
for such a legendary insect...!!
entries.translation:
He-he... Estou animado para caçar
um inseto tão lendário...!!

entries.source: I’ve got to get some apples to sell.

That's the time when business in our shop
is booming. What should I sell this year?
entries.translation:
É a época em que os negócios
bombam. O que vou vender este ano?

entries.source:
But how will I ever pick all those apples?
Hmm... I’ll need some help...
entries.translation:
Mas como vou colher tantas maçãs?
Hmm... Vou precisar de ajuda...

entries.source:
The shop owner went off to the forest
and hasn't come back.
entries.translation:
O dono da loja foi para a floresta
e ainda não voltou.

entries.source: I need to make dinner soon, but...
entries.translation: Preciso preparar o jantar logo, mas...

entries.source: Hey. Have you seen Kakashi sensei?

I've got to tell him something
important, but I can't find him
anywhere.
entries.translation:
Preciso contar algo importante
para ele, mas não o encontro
em lugar nenhum.

entries.source:
Hey, did you hear? They're putting together
a team made up only of kunoichi to take
on a mission.
entries.translation:
Ei, soube? Estão formando um time
só de kunoichi para cumprir
uma missão.

entries.source:
The ones chosen are Hinata, Sakura
and Ino. Just those three... I'm
worried.
entries.translation:
As escolhidas são Hinata, Sakura
e Ino. Só as três...
Estou preocupado.
Como será o trabalho em equipe delas?

entries.source:
Phew. I'm worn out by today's exercise
too...
entries.translation:
Ufa. O exercício de hoje também
me deixou esgotado...

entries.source:
But another team was still exercising.
What's up with them?
entries.translation:
Mas tinha outro time ainda treinando.
O que há com eles?

entries.source: Is that team still doing exercises?

Hey! Have you seen anyone suspicious
around here?
entries.translation:
Ei! Viu alguém suspeito
por aqui?

entries.source:
If you do, let me know right away!
We've got a peeping tom on our hands!
entries.translation:
Se vir, me avise na hora!
Tem um tarado nos espiando!

entries.source:
Until he's caught, I can't take a bath
in peace!
entries.translation:
Enquanto não o pegarem, não consigo
tomar banho em paz!

entries.source:
The village seems stable right now,
but it's actually far from stable.
entries.translation:
A vila parece estável agora,
mas está longe disso.

entries.source:
Some day soon, both the Akatsuki and
Orochimaru are bound to make a move
against the Leaf Village...
entries.translation:
Em breve, tanto a Akatsuki quanto
Orochimaru devem agir
contra a Vila da Folha...

entries.source:
As long as I am Hokage, it is my duty to
defend this village...
entries.translation:
Enquanto eu for Hokage, é meu dever
defender esta vila...

entries.source: Guy sensei's training with Lee again.
entries.translation: Guy-sensei está treinando com Lee de novo.

entries.source:
Sheesh... There's nothing wrong with
training, but you have to rest
sometimes!
entries.translation:
Puxa... Não há nada errado em
treinar, mas às vezes é
preciso descansar!

entries.source:
I just heard two girls talking about
dieting as they walked along.
entries.translation:
Acabei de ouvir duas garotas
conversando sobre dieta enquanto andavam.

entries.source:
Wow, even at their age they're thinking
about dieting. Kids these days grow up
too fast.
entries.translation:
Nossa, já pensam em dieta
nessa idade. As crianças de hoje
crescem rápido demais.

entries.source: I'm the one that really needs to diet.
entries.translation: Quem precisa mesmo de dieta sou eu.

entries.source:
I saw this kid going on about love
and stuff while she was training
just now... What was that about?
entries.translation:
Acabei de ver uma garota falando
de amor e coisas assim enquanto
treinava... O que era aquilo?

entries.source:
There was this amazing aura around
her... It sent shivers down my spine...
entries.translation:
Ela tinha uma aura incrível...
Cheguei a sentir arrepios...

entries.source:
Phew... What should I say to Lee and the
others? They're a bit too intense about
their training.
entries.translation:
Ufa... O que digo a Lee e aos
outros? Estão levando o treino
a sério demais.

entries.source:
But then, they're my students. Nothing
can quench their fiery spirits!
entries.translation:
Mas são meus alunos. Nada
apaga o espírito ardente deles!

entries.source:
I'd love to spar against them some more...
but something has come up...
entries.translation:
Eu adoraria treinar mais com eles...
mas surgiu um imprevisto...

entries.source:
There they go, fighting again. They're in
Squad 8, aren't they?
entries.translation:
Lá vão eles, brigando de novo.
São do Time 8, não são?

entries.source:
Yeah... They're a rowdy bunch, always
training like crazy.
entries.translation:
É... São barulhentos, sempre
treinando como loucos.

entries.source: I wish someone would break it up...
entries.translation: Queria que alguém separasse os dois...

entries.source:
Oh, man... At least they could go fight
somewhere else...
entries.translation:
Ah, cara... Pelo menos podiam
ir lutar em outro lugar...

entries.source:
Lady Tsunade, Jiraiya, and Orochimaru...
They call them the Legendary Sannin.
entries.translation:
Senhora Tsunade, Jiraiya e Orochimaru...
São os chamados Sannin Lendários.

entries.source:
I heard they're powerful, but I wonder
just how powerful.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que são poderosos, mas
queria saber quanto.

entries.source:
Either way, they must have some amazing
strength.
entries.translation:
Seja como for, devem ter uma
força incrível.

entries.source:
That girl, Tenten is it? She says she
wants another match with me.
entries.translation:
Aquela garota, Tenten, não é?
Disse que quer outra luta comigo.

entries.source:
I accepted, but it'll hardly be an
exciting match with her as an
opponent.
entries.translation:
Aceitei, mas enfrentá-la
dificilmente será
empolgante.

entries.source: At least it'll kill some time.
entries.translation: Pelo menos vai passar o tempo.

entries.source:
Oh no, where did Lady Tsunade run off
to again!? There's so much work to do...
entries.translation:
Ah, não, aonde a Senhora Tsunade
fugiu de novo?! Há tanto trabalho...

entries.source:
Where is she? If she's doing what I think
she's doing… Hmph!
entries.translation:
Onde ela está? Se estiver fazendo
o que estou pensando… Hum!

entries.source:
Lady Tsunade needs to start behaving
herself. Sigh…
entries.translation:
A Senhora Tsunade precisa começar
a se comportar. Ai, ai…

entries.source:
Those two I saw in the forest… They
looked suspicious...
entries.translation:
Aqueles dois que vi na floresta…
Pareciam suspeitos...

entries.source:
Where are those shinobi from…? They're
not Leaf… Not Sand either… Hmm.
entries.translation:
De onde são aqueles shinobi…?
Não são da Folha… Nem da Areia… Hmm.

entries.source:
It's been a while since we worked on
your Summoning Jutsu.
entries.translation:
Faz tempo que não treinamos
seu Jutsu de Invocação.

entries.source:
You could only summon a tadpole at first,
but now you can summon Gamabunta...
That's improvement.
entries.translation:
No começo, só invocava um girino,
mas agora consegue chamar Gamabunta...
Isso é progresso.

entries.source:
To think, a hopeless kid like you coming
this far. Only I could've done it! Hah-hah!!
entries.translation:
Um garoto sem jeito como você chegar
tão longe. Só eu conseguiria! Ha-ha!!

entries.source:
Was that Gaara from the Hidden Sand
Village...?
entries.translation:
Era o Gaara da Vila Oculta
da Areia...?

entries.source:
There's no mistaking him... He seemed
lost in thought.
entries.translation:
Sem dúvida era ele... Parecia
perdido em pensamentos.

entries.source:
Seeing the Sand ninja around is proof that
the two villages have improved their
relations.
entries.translation:
Ver ninjas da Areia por aqui mostra
que as duas vilas melhoraram
suas relações.

entries.source:
Oh no, don't tell me she's off gambling
somewhere!
entries.translation:
Ah, não, não me diga que saiu
para apostar em algum lugar!

entries.source:
I wonder where Tenten lost her Summoning
Scroll…?
entries.translation:
Onde será que Tenten perdeu
seu Pergaminho de Invocação…?

entries.source:
All right! I vow to continue looking
for the scroll all night long until
I find it!
entries.translation:
Muito bem! Juro que vou procurar
o pergaminho a noite inteira
até encontrá-lo!

entries.source: Sorry I can't be of help, Hinata.
The Fifth Hokage looks freaked out.
I wonder what she did now?
entries.translation: O que será que ela aprontou agora?

entries.source:
Did you see those two in the forest...?
They were into some real heavy training.
entries.translation:
Viu aqueles dois na floresta...?
Estavam treinando pesado.

entries.source:
Yeah. They were so serious they wouldn't
even talk to us.
entries.translation:
É. Estavam tão concentrados
que nem falaram com a gente.

entries.source: I guess we better train that hard too...
Wasn't one of them from the Hyuga clan?
entries.translation: Um deles não era do clã Hyuga?

entries.source: Naruto... Tenten was looking for you.

She said she wants to repay her debt to
you.
entries.translation:
Disse que quer pagar a dívida
que tem com você.

entries.source:
She must want payback for what
happened last time.
entries.translation:
Deve querer revanche pelo
que aconteceu da última vez.

entries.source:
He's better at hiding. At least that means
he's improving. That's something.
entries.translation:
Ele está se escondendo melhor.
Pelo menos isso significa progresso.

entries.source:
Wait, this is no time to be
impressed. I'll find you, Konohamaru!
entries.translation:
Espere, não é hora de ficar
impressionado. Vou te achar, Konohamaru!

entries.source:
Konohamaru is looking for you, Naruto!
He said "I'm going to challenge him
again..."
entries.translation:
Konohamaru está te procurando, Naruto!
Ele disse: "Vou desafiá-lo
de novo..."

entries.source:
Naruto. I have a message for you from
Konohamaru.
entries.translation:
Naruto. Tenho um recado
do Konohamaru para você.

entries.source:
He says "It's finally time to settle the
score!" What is that about?
entries.translation:
Ele disse: "Finalmente chegou a hora
de acertar as contas!" Do que se trata?

entries.source:
Knowing you two, it's about
getting into mischief again, right?
entries.translation:
Conhecendo vocês, tem a ver com
aprontar alguma coisa de novo, certo?

entries.source: When will the ramen I ordered get here?
entries.translation: Quando chega o lámen que pedi?

entries.source:
It's been a while since I ordered takeout
ramen.
entries.translation:
Faz tempo que pedi
o lámen para entrega.

entries.source:
That ramen's so good, it even makes
someone with a sweet tooth like me
want a bowl of it.
entries.translation:
Aquele lámen é tão bom que até
eu, que adoro doces,
fico com vontade de comer.

entries.source: But they're late with the delivery.

I've heard that a new class will be
introduced at Ninja Academy.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que vão introduzir
uma nova aula na Academia Ninja.

entries.source: I'll ask the teachers at Ninja Academy.
entries.translation: Vou perguntar aos professores da Academia.

entries.source:
I heard that Iruka set up a new race
course.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que Iruka montou uma nova
pista de corrida.

entries.source: I might try it. It sounds fun.

But I don't want to embarrass myself if
anyone's watching...
entries.translation:
Mas não quero passar vergonha
se alguém estiver olhando...

entries.source:
I heard they're holding some kind of race in
the Forest of Death. With... Anko
sensei in charge.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que vai haver uma corrida
na Floresta da Morte. Com...
Anko-sensei no comando.

entries.source:
What! She's in charge? I'm going to pass.
She's scary!
entries.translation:
O quê?! Ela no comando? Vou passar.
Ela é assustadora!

entries.source:
Anko sensei's not a bad person, but... how do
I put it? She's a little intense...
entries.translation:
Anko-sensei não é má pessoa, mas...
como posso dizer? É meio intensa...

entries.source: I'm not a huge fan of hers...

It seems Guy has come up with another
great idea.
entries.translation:
Parece que Guy teve outra
grande ideia.

entries.source: He went rushing merrily into the forest.
entries.translation: Saiu correndo todo alegre para a floresta.

entries.source:
Huh... nothing can stop him when he gets
like that…
entries.translation:
Ah... nada o detém quando
fica desse jeito…

entries.source:
The other day, we were discussing which
of the new genin is the fastest and has
the greatest leaping ability.
entries.translation:
Outro dia, discutimos qual dos
novos genins é o mais rápido
e salta mais alto.

entries.source:
So far, we agreed it's Kiba, but I
wonder if there are any other contenders.
entries.translation:
Até agora, concordamos que é Kiba,
mas será que há outros candidatos?

entries.source: Well then... How agile you are...?

Kiba’s main strengths are his leaping and
agility... I'm sure he's pretty confident.
entries.translation:
Os pontos fortes de Kiba são os saltos
e a agilidade... Deve estar bem confiante.

entries.source:
I heard that Kakashi sensei's come up
with a new training exercise.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que Kakashi-sensei criou
um novo exercício de treino.

entries.source: But he hasn't told me what it is.
entries.translation: Mas não me contou qual é.

entries.source:
I'm really curious to know what he's up
to...
entries.translation:
Estou curioso para saber o que
ele está planejando...

entries.source:
I just saw Master Jiraiya walking along
with a mischievous smile on his face...
I wonder what he's up to.
entries.translation:
Acabei de ver o Mestre Jiraiya
andando com um sorriso malicioso...
O que será que está aprontando?

entries.source:
He was muttering something about...
Naruto... and jumping...
entries.translation:
Ele murmurava alguma coisa sobre...
Naruto... e saltos...

entries.source:
Knowing him, he's up to something
strange again...
entries.translation:
Conhecendo ele, deve estar
aprontando algo estranho de novo...

entries.source:
I assigned Hinata a special mission,
but... I worry whether she can
accomplish it alone...
entries.translation:
Dei uma missão especial a Hinata,
mas... será que ela consegue
cumpri-la sozinha...?

entries.source:
I wish I could've gone with her... But
I have other missions to do...
entries.translation:
Queria ter ido com ela... Mas
tenho outras missões para fazer...

entries.source: Hinata... I wonder if she's doing okay...?

Tsunade tells me that Shizune is off
doing a mission on her own.
entries.translation:
Tsunade me disse que Shizune saiu
em uma missão sozinha.

entries.source:
It's not that I don't have confidence in
her... But... Hmm. I have a bad feeling.
entries.translation:
Não é que eu não confie nela...
Mas... Hmm. Estou com um mau pressentimento.

entries.source:
I'd like to help... But on the other hand,
I have my research to do, so...umm...
entries.translation:
Queria ajudar... Mas, por outro lado,
tenho minhas pesquisas, então... ahn...

entries.source:
I ordered Asuma and Shikamaru to go
and retrieve some pots...
entries.translation:
Mandei Asuma e Shikamaru
recuperarem alguns potes...

entries.source:
But I wonder if they're up to it.
Men are so clumsy at everything.
I’m worried...
entries.translation:
Mas será que dão conta?
Homens são tão desajeitados.
Estou preocupada...

entries.source:
There's precious cargo inside those
pots... Don’t mess this up...
entries.translation:
Há uma carga preciosa naqueles
potes... Não estraguem tudo...

entries.source: Hmm... His parcel should arrive soon...
entries.translation: Hmm... A encomenda dele já deve chegar...

entries.source:
But it doesn’t seem to be coming... I
wonder if he forgot...?
entries.translation:
Mas parece que não vem...
Será que ele esqueceu...?

entries.source:
It's my sister's wedding, but the
flowers I ordered haven't arrived.
entries.translation:
É o casamento da minha irmã, mas
as flores que pedi não chegaram.

entries.source:
There's not much time left...I wonder if
they'll make it in time...
entries.translation:
Falta pouco tempo... Será que
vão chegar a tempo...?

entries.source:
I'll wait a little longer. If they don't come I'll
have to go to the shop myself.
entries.translation:
Vou esperar mais um pouco. Se não chegarem,
vou ter que ir pessoalmente à loja.

entries.source:
Looks like that frog's been shopping.
Ha-ha. What a greedy little guy.
entries.translation:
Parece que aquele sapo fez compras.
Ha-ha. Que sujeitinho guloso.

entries.source:
But how is he ever going to get that
luggage home?
entries.translation:
Mas como ele vai levar toda
aquela bagagem para casa?

entries.source:
Hey, Naruto. There were some
Sand Ninja looking for you.
entries.translation:
Ei, Naruto. Alguns ninjas
da Areia estavam te procurando.

entries.source: Dunno what it was they wanted.

If you got time, why don't you
help 'em out?
entries.translation:
Se tiver tempo, por que não
vai ajudá-los?

entries.source:
Sasuke... He's been training for so
long... I wonder if there's anything
I can do to help...
entries.translation:
Sasuke... Está treinando há tanto
tempo... Será que posso
ajudar de alguma forma...?

entries.source: He pushes himself too hard... I'm worried...
entries.translation: Ele se esforça demais... Fico preocupada...

entries.source:
Uh... Was Naruto's team called
together...?
entries.translation:
Ahn... Chamaram o time
do Naruto...?
Vi Sasuke indo a algum lugar...

entries.source: Could it be a mission or something...?
entries.translation: Será que é uma missão ou algo assim...?

entries.source:
U-Uh... Naruto... Did you see Akamaru
anywhere...?
entries.translation:
A-Ahn... Naruto... Viu o Akamaru
em algum lugar...?

entries.source:
Akamaru's been missing for a while...
We've been looking for him, but...
entries.translation:
Akamaru sumiu faz um tempo...
Estamos procurando, mas...

entries.source:
I heard that Choji was fighting with a dog
named Pakkun over some snacks.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que Choji estava brigando com
um cachorro chamado Pakkun por lanches.

entries.source:
I hope Choji wins. Then he can share
the snacks with me!
entries.translation:
Espero que Choji vença. Assim
ele pode dividir os lanches comigo!

entries.source: I guess I should go root for Choji...
entries.translation: Acho que vou torcer por Choji...

entries.source:
Hey, Naruto. Master Jiraiya was asking
for you.
entries.translation:
Ei, Naruto. Mestre Jiraiya
estava te procurando.

entries.source:
He's trying to capture Gamakichi... or
something. Anyway, he wants your help.
entries.translation:
Ele está tentando capturar Gamakichi...
ou algo assim. Enfim, quer sua ajuda.

entries.source:
Find Master Jiraiya and he'll give you the
details.
entries.translation:
Procure o Mestre Jiraiya,
e ele te dará os detalhes.

entries.source:
This homework for the Ninja
Academy... Do you think we can
do it?
entries.translation:
Esta lição da Academia
Ninja... Será que a gente
consegue fazer?

entries.source:
Oh yeah, piece o' cake!
C'mon, let's put this thing away!
entries.translation:
Claro, é moleza!
Vamos, vamos acabar com isso!

entries.source: Hmm, how should we handle this?
We've got a lot of homework again...

Iruka sensei doesn't cut us any
slack, does he?
entries.translation:
Iruka-sensei não dá
folga para a gente, né?

entries.source:
I think I'm getting used to Iruka
sensei's homework.
entries.translation:
Acho que estou me acostumando
à lição do Iruka-sensei.

entries.source:
Yeah, we can get this done
lickety-split!
entries.translation:
É, vamos terminar isso
num instante!

entries.source:
If we keep this up, maybe we can
become great ninja...
entries.translation:
Se continuarmos assim, talvez
viremos grandes ninjas...

entries.source:
Let's finish this one quick!
Iruka sensei'll be so surprised!
entries.translation:
Vamos terminar logo!
Iruka-sensei vai se surpreender!

entries.source: A... All right... Let's do it!
I... I'll stay out of your way...

D... Don't you think the homework
this time is a LITTLE too much?
entries.translation:
V... Você não acha que a lição
desta vez é um POUCO exagerada?

entries.source:
...Yeah.
I dunno if we can do it...
Y... You think we can do it all?
entries.translation: A... Acha que conseguimos fazer tudo?

entries.source:
Hmmm... Maybe we better ask
Konohamaru for help...
entries.translation:
Hmmm... Talvez seja melhor pedir
ajuda ao Konohamaru...

entries.source:
My parents are always on my case.
"When are you going to get off your
butt and become a chunin?"
entries.translation:
Meus pais vivem pegando no meu pé.
"Quando vai levantar daí
e virar uma chunin?"

entries.source:
Life's no fun if you're always
rushing everything! You're better
off taking the time to do it right.
entries.translation:
A vida perde a graça se você
corre para fazer tudo! É melhor
fazer com calma e direito.

entries.source:
Slow and steady...
That's my nindo.
entries.translation:
Devagar e sempre...
Esse é meu Nindo.

entries.source:
The Chunin Exam, Orochimaru's
assault... You've been through more
than anyone should have to, Naruto.
entries.translation:
O Exame Chunin, o ataque de
Orochimaru... Você passou por mais
coisas do que deveria, Naruto.

entries.source:
Use that experience as sustenance
for what lies ahead. Don't just
toss it aside, you hear?
entries.translation:
Use essa experiência para se
fortalecer diante do que vem aí.
Não a desperdice, ouviu?

entries.source:
Even the smallest things have some
meaning to them. It's a good idea to
reflect on the past once in a while.
entries.translation:
Até as menores coisas têm algum
significado. É bom refletir
sobre o passado de vez em quando.

entries.source: Hi! I came to help you out!

Hey! You're late. How come you kept me waiting so
long?
entries.translation:
Ei! Você está atrasado. Por que
me deixou esperando tanto?

entries.source: But I just found out about it...

Skip it. No more excuses. Let's get
serious!
entries.translation:
Deixa para lá. Chega de desculpas.
Vamos levar isso a sério!

entries.source:
Ready? I need you to pick only the flowers
I tell you to pick, got it?
entries.translation:
Pronto? Preciso que colha só as flores
que eu mandar, entendeu?

entries.source:
Remember, if you bring back any weird-looking
flowers, you're gonna be sorry.
entries.translation:
Lembre-se: se trouxer flores estranhas,
vai se arrepender.

entries.source:
Okay, first get me 3 red flowers. I
think some are growing over there.
entries.translation:
Primeiro, traga 3 flores vermelhas.
Acho que há algumas por ali.

entries.source:
Tsk... If they're nearby, why
doesn't she go pick 'em herself?
entries.translation:
Tsc... Se estão tão perto, por que
ela mesma não vai buscar?

entries.source: No! Nothing! I'll be going now!
Hey, hurry up! Get me those red flowers!
entries.translation: Ei, depressa! Traga as flores vermelhas!

entries.source: Hey, hurry up! Get me 3 red flowers!

You forgot what I told you,
didn't you...
entries.translation:
Você esqueceu o que eu disse,
não foi...

entries.source: *Sigh* I was stupid to think YOU could help.
entries.translation: *Suspiro* Fui boba de achar que VOCÊ ajudaria.

entries.source:
That's enough... It'll be faster if I
find the flowers myself.
entries.translation:
Já chega... Vai ser mais rápido
eu mesma encontrar as flores.

entries.source: (S-she didn't have to sigh so LOUD...)

entries.translation: Inacreditável...! Você não serve para nada...!

entries.source:
Good! It looks like you picked the
right ones! You're not as dumb as
you look.
entries.translation:
Ótimo! Parece que colheu as certas!
Não é tão bobo quanto
parece.

entries.source:
Huh? What are you talking about?
You're just getting started.
entries.translation:
Hã? Do que está falando?
Você só está começando.

entries.source:
Next, I need blue flowers and yellow
flowers... And...
entries.translation:
Agora preciso de flores azuis
e amarelas... E...

entries.source:
H-Hey. Hold on!! You're saying I need to
gather all those flowers!?
entries.translation:
E-Ei. Espere!! Está dizendo que
tenho que colher todas essas flores?!

entries.source:
And quick. We're keeping the
customer who ordered them waiting.
entries.translation:
E rápido. Estamos deixando o
cliente que encomendou esperando.

entries.source:
Come on! Hurry up and gather the
flowers!
entries.translation:
Vamos! Ande logo e colha
as flores!

entries.source:
I need you to get 5 blue flowers,
4 yellow flowers, and 6 black flowers!
entries.translation:
Preciso de 5 flores azuis,
4 amarelas e 6 pretas!

entries.source:
We don't have much time left, so let's
get cracking! Move it, Naruto!
entries.translation:
Temos pouco tempo, então vamos
começar! Mexa-se, Naruto!

entries.source:
Gather "5 blue flowers, 4 yellow
flowers, and 6 black flowers" within the
time limit!
entries.translation:
Recolha "5 flores azuis, 4 amarelas
e 6 pretas" antes de o
tempo acabar!

entries.source: Oh, did you gather those flowers already?

You need to gather blue flowers,
yellow flowers and black flowers, got
it!?
entries.translation:
Você precisa de flores azuis,
amarelas e pretas,
entendeu?!

entries.source:
Gather 5 blue flowers, 4 yellow
flowers, and 6 black flowers!
entries.translation:
Recolha 5 flores azuis, 4 amarelas
e 6 pretas!

entries.source: Huh!? Did I do something wrong!?

Are they wrong?! Yeah, almost every one!
Weren’t you listening?
entries.translation:
Errada?! Sim, quase tudo!
Você não estava ouvindo?

entries.source:
Don't give me excuses! Oh, no! What are
we gonna do!?
entries.translation:
Não me dê desculpas! Ah, não!
O que vamos fazer?!

entries.source:
We're supposed to make the customers happy,
not angry that they had to wait so long!
entries.translation:
Devemos deixar os clientes felizes,
não irritados por esperar tanto!

entries.source:
Now I've got to apologize to her!
Just you wait, Naruto. You're gonna pay
for this…
entries.translation:
Agora preciso me desculpar com ela!
Você vai ver, Naruto.
Vai pagar por isso…

entries.source:
I'm scared to think what kind of
revenge she has in store...
entries.translation:
Tenho medo de pensar na
vingança que ela está preparando...

entries.source:
Whattaya know! You got all the flowers
right!
entries.translation:
Olha só! Você acertou todas
as flores!

entries.source: Heh-heh! Sure! I said I would, didn't I?
entries.translation: Heh-heh! Claro! Eu disse que conseguiria!

entries.source:
I think we'll just make it in time!
Good work, Naruto!
entries.translation:
Acho que ainda dá tempo!
Bom trabalho, Naruto!

entries.source:
If you ever find any nice flowers,
bring them to our shop. We'll buy them
from you.
entries.translation:
Se encontrar flores bonitas,
traga para a nossa loja.
Vamos comprá-las de você.

entries.source:
But if you bring in weird ones, you'll be sorry.
So keep that in mind.
entries.translation:
Mas, se trouxer flores estranhas,
vai se arrepender. Não se esqueça.

entries.source: See you around. Thanks for the help.

I don't know why... But I always feel
exhausted after talking to her.
entries.translation:
Não sei por quê... Mas sempre fico
exausto depois de falar com ela.

entries.source: ...This is the best I can do...
You took so long, the customer cancelled!
entries.translation: Você demorou tanto que o cliente cancelou!

entries.source: Hey, I'm sorry. I did my best...
entries.translation: Ei, desculpe. Fiz o que pude...

entries.source:
You're gonna pay for this, Naruto!
Some day you're gonna pay!
entries.translation:
Você vai pagar por isso, Naruto!
Um dia vai pagar!

entries.source: Hey, Shino! I've come to help you!

You're so loud you frightened all the
insects away.
entries.translation:
Você faz tanto barulho que
espantou todos os insetos.

entries.source:
What are you going to do to make
things right?
entries.translation:
O que vai fazer para
consertar isso?

entries.source:
What do you mean? I just came to help
you out...
entries.translation:
Como assim? Só vim
te ajudar...

entries.source:
I see... Then you can make amends by
assisting me.
entries.translation:
Entendo... Então pode compensar
me ajudando.

entries.source: (Make amends...? Is he still mad at me?)

What I am looking for now is a legendary
beetle.
entries.translation:
O que procuro agora é um
besouro lendário.

entries.source:
It's a very beautiful insect with a golden
body.
entries.translation:
É um inseto muito bonito
com corpo dourado.

entries.source:
Yeah? A bug with a gold body oughtta
be easy to spot, right?
entries.translation:
É? Um inseto dourado deve
ser fácil de achar, certo?

entries.source:
The forest is huge and the beetle
is small. It will be hard to find
even if you look carefully.
entries.translation:
A floresta é enorme, e o besouro
é pequeno. Será difícil encontrá-lo
mesmo procurando com cuidado.

entries.source:
Just leave it to me, I've got eyes
like a hawk!
entries.translation:
Deixe comigo, tenho
olhos de águia!

entries.source:
Hmm. We haven't much time before
I promised to return to the client. I'm
counting on you, Naruto.
entries.translation:
Hmm. Falta pouco para o horário
que prometi voltar ao cliente.
Conto com você, Naruto.

entries.source: What's is it...? Did you capture it?

Don't forget, the beetle you're looking
for is golden.
entries.translation:
Não se esqueça: o besouro que
procura é dourado.

entries.source:
What are you doing? This isn't the
insect I asked you for.
entries.translation:
O que está fazendo? Este não
é o inseto que pedi.

entries.source: Whaat!? I - I caught the wrong one?
entries.translation: O quê?! E-Eu peguei o errado?

entries.source: I guess it was too difficult for you.
entries.translation: Acho que foi difícil demais para você.

entries.source:
It can't be helped. I should have had my
insects guide me.
entries.translation:
Não tem jeito. Eu devia ter pedido
aos meus insetos para me guiar.

entries.source:
Heeeey! If you could've done that,
why didn't you?!
entries.translation:
Eeei! Se podia fazer isso,
por que não fez?!

entries.source: See you, Naruto. I have to go.

Was he joking or what?...
It's hard to tell with him…
entries.translation:
Ele estava brincando ou não?...
Com ele é difícil saber…

entries.source: Good job. You found the legendary beetle.
entries.translation: Bom trabalho. Encontrou o besouro lendário.

entries.source:
Now I'll just deliver it to the
client.
entries.translation:
Agora só preciso entregá-lo
ao cliente.

entries.source: Yeah! I'll leave that to you.

entries.translation: O cliente me disse uma coisa.

entries.source:
If you catch other rare insects, bring them
to his shop. He'll buy them.
entries.translation:
Se capturar outros insetos raros,
leve à loja dele. Ele os comprará.

entries.source:
Yeah? Then, I'll start bug-collecting in
my spare time.
entries.translation:
É? Então vou começar a caçar
insetos nas horas vagas.

entries.source:
All right, then. You helped me a lot today.
Thanks.
entries.translation:
Muito bem. Você me ajudou muito hoje.
Obrigado.

entries.source:
That may be the first time he's ever
thanked anyone. It feels weird…
entries.translation:
Talvez seja a primeira vez que ele
agradece a alguém. Que estranho…

entries.source:
I had a little difficulty. Well...
actually...
entries.translation:
Tive um pouco de dificuldade. Bem...
na verdade...

entries.source:
You took so long that I went and
caught the legendary beetle myself.
entries.translation:
Você demorou tanto que fui
capturar o besouro lendário sozinho.

entries.source:
Phew... It was quite easy for me... no
trouble at all...
entries.translation:
Ufa... Foi bem fácil para mim...
Sem dificuldade alguma...

entries.source: So... I went to all that trouble...

But I can't say I'm surprised
how it turned out.
entries.translation:
Mas não posso dizer que estou
surpreso com o resultado.

entries.source:
Borrowed the Bug-catching Net from
Shino.
entries.translation:
Pegou a Rede de Insetos
emprestada de Shino.

entries.source:
Shino took back the Bug-catching
Net and headed off.
entries.translation:
Shino pegou a Rede de Insetos
de volta e foi embora.

entries.source:
Then why don't you hang on to the
Bug-catching Net? I think a little
collecting would be good for you.
entries.translation:
Então por que não fica com a
Rede de Insetos? Acho que coletar
um pouco faria bem a você.

entries.source:
Haha! Thanks, Shino!
I'll be sure to put it to good use!
entries.translation:
Haha! Obrigado, Shino!
Vou fazer bom uso dela!

entries.source:
With a slump in his shoulders, Naruto
handed back the Bug-catching Net
to Shino...
entries.translation:
Com os ombros caídos, Naruto
devolveu a Rede de Insetos
a Shino...

entries.source:
Uh, are you the person looking for
fruit-pickers..?
entries.translation:
Ahn, é você que está procurando
colhedores de frutas...?

entries.source:
Eh? Yes, that's me. Are you the
person who's going to help us?
entries.translation:
Hã? Sim, sou eu. Você é
quem vai nos ajudar?

entries.source:
You betcha! You couldn't've picked a
better fruit-picker than me!
entries.translation:
Pode apostar! Não podia ter
escolhido um colhedor melhor!

entries.source:
Thank you! I need to gather lots and
lots of of fruit!
entries.translation:
Obrigada! Preciso colher muitas
e muitas frutas!

entries.source:
Yes! They're always our best-selling
fruit!
entries.translation:
Sim! São sempre as frutas
que mais vendemos!

entries.source:
So, I want to get lots of them,
and make my mother happy!
entries.translation:
Então quero conseguir muitas
para deixar minha mãe feliz!

entries.source:
Uh-huh. I got it! I'll take care of
everything!
entries.translation:
Aham. Entendi! Vou cuidar
de tudo!

entries.source: Wow! You're a dream come true!
entries.translation: Nossa! Você é um sonho realizado!

entries.source:
(I've never been called a dream come
true before... Hee-hee!)
entries.translation:
(Nunca disseram que sou um sonho
realizado... Hee-hee!)

entries.source:
I think 20 would be enough. Do you
think you could gather that many?
entries.translation:
Acho que 20 bastam. Consegue
recolher essa quantidade?

entries.source:
I think ** would be enough.
Do you think you could gather that
many?
entries.translation:
Acho que ** bastam.
Consegue recolher
essa quantidade?

entries.source:
Leave it to me! Once I get started,
there's no stopping me!!
entries.translation:
Deixe comigo! Quando começo,
ninguém me para!!

entries.source:
My mother will be angry if I stay out
too long, so let's finish as quickly
as possible!
entries.translation:
Minha mãe fica brava se eu demorar
muito, então vamos terminar
o mais rápido possível!

entries.source:
What is it? Have you gathered them
already?
entries.translation:
O que foi? Já
recolheu tudo?

entries.source:
Uh... could you go find me 20 apples? I
want to make my mother happy!
entries.translation:
Ahn... Pode buscar 20 maçãs?
Quero deixar minha mãe feliz!

entries.source:
Uh... could you go find me ** apples? I
want to make my mother happy!
entries.translation:
Ahn... Pode buscar ** maçãs?
Quero deixar minha mãe feliz!

entries.source: Really!? Let me see, let me see!
Well... um... ahaha... Not good enough?
entries.translation: Bem... ahn... ahaha... Não está bom?

entries.source:
Forget it... I shouldn't have relied on
you.
entries.translation:
Esqueça... Eu não devia ter
contado com você.

entries.source:
(I've never felt like such a jerk before
in my LIFE...)
entries.translation:
(Nunca me senti tão idiota
na VIDA...)

entries.source: I wanted to make my mother happy...

Wah! That's more than enough!
My mother will be sooo happy!
entries.translation:
Uau! É mais que suficiente!
Minha mãe vai ficar tão feliz!

entries.source:
Well, I've got to go now, and you
should go home soon too, okay?
entries.translation:
Bom, preciso ir, e você
também devia voltar logo, certo?

entries.source:
If you ever pick any more fruit, you can
always bring it to the fruit shop in the village.
entries.translation:
Se colher mais frutas, pode
levá-las à frutaria da vila.

entries.source: I'm sure my mother will buy it.
entries.translation: Tenho certeza de que minha mãe comprará.

entries.source:
That's good to know! I'll bring some
next time!
entries.translation:
Bom saber! Vou trazer
algumas da próxima vez!

entries.source:
We'lll be waiting for you! Thanks
a lot for today!
entries.translation:
Vamos esperar você! Muito
obrigada por hoje!

entries.source: I have to get them back to the shop soon.
Phew... Well, that oughta do it for now.
entries.translation: Ufa... Bem, por enquanto deve bastar.

entries.source: Hey, you're in a good mood! What's up?
entries.translation: Ei, está de bom humor! O que houve?

entries.source:
A really cool ninja gathered all these
apples for me! Look!
entries.translation:
Um ninja muito legal colheu todas
essas maçãs para mim! Olhe!

entries.source:
He'd gathered them before I knew it!
Said it was easy!
entries.translation:
Ele colheu tudo sem eu perceber!
Disse que foi fácil!

entries.source: W... well... Wasn't that nice of him...
entries.translation: B... Bem... Que gentil da parte dele...

entries.source: Hahaha... Makes me look pretty lame...
I hope I meet that ninja again...

Choji was helping me gather
mushrooms, but...
entries.translation:
Choji estava me ajudando a
recolher cogumelos, mas...

entries.source: I think he ate some poison mushrooms.

Well, they're poisonous, but this
kind isn't life-threatening, so don't
worry.
entries.translation:
São venenosos, mas este tipo
não oferece risco de vida,
então não se preocupe.

entries.source:
They just give you a a severe stomachache
for a while.
entries.translation:
Só causam uma dor de barriga
muito forte por um tempo.

entries.source:
No, it's not good!
Shouldn't we try to cure him?
entries.translation:
Não, não é bom!
Não devíamos tentar curá-lo?

entries.source:
We need to find a “Recovery
Mushroom” to relieve his stomachache.
entries.translation:
Precisamos achar um “Cogumelo
Curativo” para aliviar a dor.

entries.source:
It has a red top and it relieves many
different symptoms.
entries.translation:
Tem o chapéu vermelho e alivia
vários sintomas diferentes.

entries.source: I see. So I should go pick some, right?
entries.translation: Entendi. Então é só ir buscar, certo?

entries.source:
I'd better stay with Choji. I'll leave the
mushroom-picking to you.
entries.translation:
É melhor eu ficar com Choji.
Deixo a busca do cogumelo com você.

entries.source:
I'll bring it back in no time!
Hang in there, Choji.
entries.translation:
Volto num instante!
Aguente firme, Choji.

entries.source:
Bring me a mushroom with a red top. I'm
counting on you.
entries.translation:
Traga um cogumelo de chapéu vermelho.
Conto com você.

entries.source: Excellent! Thanks, this will help a lot!

entries.translation: O quê...? ...O que você estava fazendo...?

entries.source: What!? Did I get it wrong?!
H-Hey! Let's get him to the hospital!!
Well, we got him treated, but...

Ah! It really is a Recovery Mushroom.
Good job finding it!
entries.translation:
Ah! É mesmo um Cogumelo Curativo.
Bom trabalho encontrando isso!

entries.source: Now we just need to make him eat it...
Phew... You saved my life, Naruto.
entries.translation: Ufa... Você salvou minha vida, Naruto.

entries.source: Hmm... Don't scare me like that.

But if you found yummy-looking
mushrooms, wouldn't you want to eat
them?
entries.translation:
Mas, se encontrasse cogumelos
apetitosos, não ia querer
comê-los?

entries.source: No, I think I could resist.
Yeah. Thanks, to both of you.

Problem solved, so I'll head
back to the village now.
entries.translation:
Problema resolvido. Vou voltar
para a vila agora.

entries.source:
Oh. If you ever find another Recovery
Mushroom, could you bring it to my shop?
entries.translation:
Ah. Se achar outro Cogumelo
Curativo, pode levar à minha loja?

entries.source:
Oh, now I remember you. You run...a
vegetable stand?
entries.translation:
Ah, agora me lembro de você.
Você tem... uma banca de verduras?

entries.source:
Yeah. Not only Recovery Mushrooms, but
any edible kind of mushroom is always
welcome.
entries.translation:
Sim. Não só Cogumelos Curativos,
mas qualquer cogumelo comestível
é sempre bem-vindo.

entries.source:
If you spot any yummy-looking
mushrooms, bring them to me. I'll pay
you a generous reward.
entries.translation:
Se achar cogumelos apetitosos,
traga para mim. Vou te pagar
uma boa recompensa.

entries.source:
Okay! If I find any mushrooms, I'll
bring them to you!
entries.translation:
Certo! Se achar cogumelos,
vou trazer para você!

entries.source:
Y'know, that mushroom didn't taste
half bad. If only there was a way to
eat 'em without the belly-ache...
entries.translation:
Sabe, aquele cogumelo até que era
gostoso. Se houvesse um jeito de
comer sem dor de barriga...

entries.source:
If you find some mushrooms, bring them
to the vegetable stand in the village.
entries.translation:
Se achar cogumelos, leve-os
à banca de verduras da vila.

entries.source:
Oh.... oh no! His condition is getting
worse!!
entries.translation:
Ah... ah, não! O estado dele
está piorando!!

entries.source: He got treated just in time...
entries.translation: Ele foi tratado bem a tempo...

entries.source:
Oh, there you are. What are you
doing over here, Kakashi sensei?
Thinking about stuff?
entries.translation:
Ah, aí está você. O que faz
por aqui, Kakashi-sensei?
Pensando na vida?

entries.source:
Hmm. Well. Uh, Sakura is looking for
you, Kakashi sensei...
entries.translation:
Hmm. Bem. Ahn, Sakura está
procurando você, Kakashi-sensei...

entries.source:
I was actually thinking about a
new course of training for you guys.
entries.translation:
Na verdade, estava pensando em
um novo treino para vocês.

entries.source:
I was just about to ask you to try it
out...
entries.translation:
Eu ia mesmo pedir para você
experimentar...

entries.source: How does that sound? Wanna try?
Sure! Glad to! This is my lucky day!
entries.translation: Claro! Com prazer! É meu dia de sorte!

entries.source:
(There aren't too many people who
think they're LUCKY for having to train...)
entries.translation:
(Não é todo mundo que acha uma
SORTE ter que treinar...)

entries.source: Alright. Let's see how far you can get.
entries.translation: Certo. Vamos ver até onde você chega.
Ei, o que há com você?

entries.source: Not good enough. That won't cut it...
entries.translation: Não foi bom o bastante. Assim não dá...

entries.source:
I'd like to continue training but,
unfortunately, I have other things to
do.
entries.translation:
Queria continuar o treino, mas,
infelizmente, tenho outras
coisas a fazer.

entries.source:
I'll practice with you again sometime.
Keep working at it till then.
entries.translation:
Vamos treinar juntos outra hora.
Até lá, continue se esforçando.

entries.source:
Okay. Just wait, I'll definitely
nail it next time...
entries.translation:
Certo. Pode esperar, com certeza
vou conseguir na próxima...

entries.source:
Aaaah!! I didn't tell him that
Sakura's looking for him!
entries.translation:
Aaaah!! Não disse que
Sakura está procurando ele!

entries.source: Oh, no!! She's gonna be maaad...
entries.translation: Ah, não!! Ela vai ficar furiosa...

entries.source: Well, you did a good job.
entries.translation: Bem, você fez um bom trabalho.

entries.source: Heh-heh! Just like I knew I would.

Well, training's over, so I'll be off.
I've got something important to do.
entries.translation:
O treino acabou, então vou indo.
Tenho algo importante a fazer.

entries.source:
Something important...? Why does that sound
familiar...?
entries.translation:
Algo importante...? Por que isso
parece familiar...?

entries.source:
You know what? Sakura was looking for
you, Kakashi sensei.
entries.translation:
Sabe de uma coisa? Sakura estava
procurando você, Kakashi-sensei.

entries.source:
She said she needs to tell you something
important!
entries.translation:
Disse que precisa te contar
algo importante!

entries.source: All right. I'll go find her then.

Phew. I almost forgot... That was
a close one.
entries.translation:
Ufa. Quase esqueci...
Foi por pouco.

entries.source: Hey! You look like you're working hard!
entries.translation: Ei! Parece que estão se esforçando!

entries.source: Oh,, Naruto. What brings you here?
entries.translation: Ah, Naruto. O que te traz aqui?

entries.source:
Well, I wondered what a team made up
only of kunoichi would be like.
entries.translation:
Bem, queria ver como seria
um time só de kunoichi.
O que você tem a ver com isso?

entries.source:
Uh... thank you for asking. You came all the
way out here...?
entries.translation:
Ahn... Obrigada por perguntar.
Você veio até aqui...?

entries.source: How're you doing on your teamwork?
entries.translation: Como vai o trabalho em equipe?

entries.source: He-he. Wanna give it a shot?

Sure, why not? Show me what this
new team of yours has got.
entries.translation:
Claro, por que não? Mostrem do
que esse novo time é capaz.

entries.source: Alright. Ino, Hinata. Are you ready?
Hey, Naruto. Did you go easy on us?
entries.translation: Ei, Naruto. Você pegou leve com a gente?

entries.source: Guess our work here is done.

*Sigh*... If that was really everything
you've got, then don't worry about us.
Worry about yourself!
entries.translation:
*Suspiro*... Se isso foi mesmo tudo
o que você tem, não se preocupe
conosco. Preocupe-se com você!

entries.source: U-Uh... You didn't... have to say that...
entries.translation: A-Ahn... Você não... precisava dizer isso...

entries.source: Let's get back to our training!
You need to buckle down and train harder.
entries.translation: Precisa se dedicar e treinar mais.

entries.source: I thought there was no way we'd lose...
entries.translation: Achei que não tinha como perdermos...

entries.source:
You guys still have a long way to go!
You sure you're ready for your mission?
I'm worried.
entries.translation:
Vocês ainda têm muito que melhorar!
Têm certeza de que estão prontas
para a missão? Fico preocupado.

entries.source:
Sakura, Hinata! Time for some intensive
training!
entries.translation:
Sakura, Hinata! Hora de um
treino intensivo!

entries.source:
You got it! We can't just sit back and let
this goofball laugh at us!
entries.translation:
Pode deixar! Não vamos deixar
esse idiota rir da gente!

entries.source:
Hey, Naruto. You're in the way of our
training!
entries.translation:
Ei, Naruto. Está atrapalhando
nosso treino!

entries.source:
(Anyway, at least I got 'em to get serious
about their training...)
entries.translation:
(Enfim, pelo menos fiz elas levarem
o treino a sério...)

entries.source: Let's try that team maneuver again!
entries.translation: Vamos tentar aquela manobra em equipe de novo!

entries.source: I never thought we'd lose to you.
entries.translation: Nunca imaginei que perderíamos para você.

entries.source:
Asuma sensei. I came here to help you
exercise.
entries.translation:
Asuma-sensei. Vim ajudar vocês
no treino.

entries.source:
Heh, thanks for coming. Then, let's get
started.
entries.translation:
Heh, obrigado por vir.
Então vamos começar.

entries.source:
Tsk... He isn't still asleep is
he...?
entries.translation:
Tsc... Ele não está dormindo
ainda, está...?

entries.source:
It can't be helped. Ino, will you fetch
Shikamaru?
entries.translation:
Não tem jeito. Ino, pode buscar
Shikamaru?

entries.source: Asuma sensei. Should we just wait?
No, we'll get started with you.

Warm up your body a little. Try some
light sparring with Naruto.
entries.translation:
Aqueça o corpo um pouco. Faça
um treino leve contra Naruto.

entries.source: He-he. Choji! I won't go easy on you.
entries.translation: He-he. Choji! Não vou pegar leve.

entries.source:
Ow... I'm gonna make Shikamaru pay
for this...
entries.translation:
Ai... Shikamaru vai
me pagar por isso...

entries.source: Oh? Is that the best you can do, Naruto?
entries.translation: Ah? É só isso que consegue, Naruto?

entries.source:
If that's all you've got, Naruto, you're
no help at all.
entries.translation:
Se isso é tudo, Naruto,
você não ajuda em nada.

entries.source: Sorry, but we don't need you.
entries.translation: Desculpe, mas não precisamos de você.

entries.source: You'd better ask Kakashi to train you.
entries.translation: É melhor pedir ao Kakashi para te treinar.

entries.source:
Ow... Having to move around makes me
hungry.
entries.translation:
Ai... Ficar me mexendo
me dá fome.

entries.source:
Hang in there. After this exercise, I'll
treat you to something.
entries.translation:
Aguente firme. Depois do treino,
vou pagar uma coisa para você.

entries.source: Tsk. I was in the middle of a nice nap.
entries.translation: Tsc. Eu estava no meio de um belo cochilo.

entries.source:
You completely forgot about today's
exercise, didn't you?
entries.translation:
Esqueceu completamente o treino
de hoje, não foi?

entries.source:
*Sigh...* Never mind. I'll save the
tardiness lecture for later. At last all
Squad 10 members are assembled.
entries.translation:
*Suspiro...* Deixa para lá. Guardo
o sermão pelo atraso para depois.
Finalmente o Time 10 está reunido.

entries.source:
You'll try to strengthen your teamwork in a
practice match against Naruto.
entries.translation:
Vocês vão melhorar o trabalho em equipe
em uma luta de treino contra Naruto.

entries.source:
Teamwork...? But we've been doing
pretty good so far.
entries.translation:
Trabalho em equipe...? Mas estamos
indo bem até agora.

entries.source:
I agree, even by my high standards.
But I want you to improve it even
more, for the future.
entries.translation:
Concordo, mesmo com minha exigência.
Mas quero que melhorem
ainda mais, pensando no futuro.

entries.source:
Improving our teamwork... Okay,
let's get started.
entries.translation:
Melhorar o trabalho em equipe...
Certo, vamos começar.

entries.source:
Naruto. I want you to come at them
and don't go easy on them.
entries.translation:
Naruto. Quero que ataque
sem pegar leve com eles.

entries.source: Yeah! Hang on to your hats!

Hey, hey. Don't cave in so quickly.
I haven't broken a sweat yet.
entries.translation:
Ei, ei. Não desista tão rápido.
Ainda nem comecei a suar.

entries.source:
No, that's enough. Naruto. I think
you've hit your limit.
entries.translation:
Não, já chega. Naruto, acho
que você chegou ao limite.

entries.source:
It's sooner than I planned, but
let's call it a day. Each of you can
do some exercises on your own.
entries.translation:
Antes do que planejei, mas
vamos encerrar por hoje. Cada um
pode treinar por conta própria.

entries.source: (Gah... I was no help at all...)
You've got a long way to go.
entries.translation: Você ainda tem muito que melhorar.

entries.source:
I have to get back the village and watch
the store.
entries.translation:
Preciso voltar à vila
e cuidar da loja.

entries.source:
Shikamaru. Have you learned anything
from this?
entries.translation:
Shikamaru. Aprendeu alguma
coisa com isso?

entries.source:
I guess... we shouldn't get too cocky
about our teamwork.
entries.translation:
Acho que... não devemos confiar
demais no nosso trabalho em equipe.

entries.source:
Well, if you undertsand that, you know
what you have to do, right?
entries.translation:
Se entendeu isso, sabe
o que precisa fazer, certo?

entries.source:
As for Naruto. Your performance exceeded
my expectations.
entries.translation:
E quanto a você, Naruto, seu
desempenho superou minhas expectativas.

entries.source: Kakashi has got himself a good student.

Ha-ha-ha! Well, I think so too! A pretty
GREAT student, actually.
entries.translation:
Ha-ha-ha! Também acho! Um
ÓTIMO aluno, na verdade.

entries.source:
But you should work on that habit of yours
of getting carried away.
entries.translation:
Mas precisa controlar esse seu
hábito de se empolgar demais.

entries.source: Little jerk's not listening to him at all.

The rest of you know you've got to work
harder on your exercises.
entries.translation:
Vocês já sabem que precisam
se esforçar mais no treino.

entries.source:
Oww... I've gone two rounds, I'm
starving...
entries.translation:
Ai... Lutei duas vezes, estou
morrendo de fome...

entries.source:
I never thought we'd be beaten by
you. Honestly... I just can't take it...
entries.translation:
Nunca imaginei que você fosse
nos vencer. Sério... não suporto isso...

entries.source: Asuma's got a strange way of teaching... Tsk.
entries.translation: Asuma tem um jeito estranho de ensinar... Tsc.

entries.source: What are you doing, Pervy Sage?
entries.translation: O que está fazendo, Sábio Tarado?

entries.source:
*Sigh* You can't spy on people all the time
and get away with it...
entries.translation:
*Suspiro* Não pode ficar espiando os
outros o tempo todo e sair impune...

entries.source:
Ha-ha-ha! I can't, can't I? I'm one
of the Legendary Sannin!
entries.translation:
Ha-ha-ha! Não posso? Sou um
dos Sannin Lendários!

entries.source: I don't get caught that easily!

(Like this is really something to brag
about...)
entries.translation:
(Como se fosse motivo
para se orgulhar...)

entries.source:
I'm afraid your wicked deeds have finally
caught up with you.
entries.translation:
Receio que suas maldades finalmente
te alcançaram.

entries.source:
I mean that you, Pervy Sage, are a
wanted man! And I'm not gonna let
you go!
entries.translation:
Quero dizer que você, Sábio Tarado,
é um homem procurado! E não vou
deixar você fugir!

entries.source:
What!? You wouldn't betray me,
Naruto?
entries.translation:
O quê?! Não vai me trair,
Naruto, vai?

entries.source: Betray? Like I'm part of this!
entries.translation: Trair? Como se eu estivesse nessa!

entries.source:
Ha-ha-ha! You idiot! You think you can
stop me?
entries.translation:
Ha-ha-ha! Idiota! Acha que
pode me deter?

entries.source: Oh no. I let him escape...
Looks like this is it, Pervy Sage!

Peace will finally be restored in the
village.
entries.translation:
A paz finalmente vai voltar
à vila.

entries.source: ...Is that what you expected me to say?

Ha-ha-ha! Did you really think you're
anywhere close to being able to
catch me?
entries.translation:
Ha-ha-ha! Achou mesmo que
estava perto de conseguir
me pegar?

entries.source:
I can't let him escape. Gotta catch him
no matter what!!
entries.translation:
Não posso deixá-lo fugir. Tenho
que pegá-lo de qualquer jeito!!

entries.source: Oh, no! I couldn't find him!!
That Pervy Sage better watch out...!
entries.translation: É bom o Sábio Tarado tomar cuidado...!

entries.source: I won't let you escape again!
entries.translation: Não vou deixar você fugir de novo!

entries.source: Kakashi, deal with Naruto, will you?
entries.translation: Kakashi, cuide do Naruto, pode ser?

entries.source:
Hold on. I can't let you catch Master
Jiraiya.
entries.translation:
Espere. Não posso deixar que pegue
o Mestre Jiraiya.

entries.source:
Kakashi sensei! Please get out of my
way!
entries.translation:
Kakashi-sensei! Por favor, saia
da minha frente!

entries.source:
Sorry, but grownups have their own
reasons for doing things.
entries.translation:
Desculpe, mas adultos têm seus
motivos para fazer as coisas.

entries.source:
Did he promise to give you some
Make-Out merchandise, huh?
entries.translation:
Ele prometeu alguma coisa de
Paraíso da Pegação para você, né?

entries.source: That-- That has nothing to do with...
entries.translation: Isso... Isso não tem nada a ver com...

entries.source:
*Sigh* That makes you an accomplice,
Kakashi sensei! Sorry, but I can't let you
stop me capturing Pervy Sage!
entries.translation:
*Suspiro* Então você é cúmplice,
Kakashi-sensei! Não vou deixar
que me impeça de pegar o Sábio Tarado!

entries.source:
Hmm? What's the matter, Naruto? Is that
all you've got?
entries.translation:
Hmm? O que foi, Naruto?
É só isso que consegue?

entries.source: I guess I need to train you harder.
entries.translation: Acho que preciso treinar você mais.

entries.source: Good job. I'll see you later.

Seems to me he made a pretty hasty
retreat...
entries.translation:
Acho que ele bateu em retirada
bem depressa...

entries.source:
No time to worry about that. I have to
catch that Pervy Sage!
entries.translation:
Não é hora de pensar nisso. Preciso
pegar aquele Sábio Tarado!

entries.source: That Pervy Sage better watch out...!
entries.translation: É bom o Sábio Tarado tomar cuidado...!

entries.source:
Pervy Sage! I won't let you escape
again!
entries.translation:
Sábio Tarado! Não vou deixar
você escapar de novo!

entries.source: I'm going all out! You better be ready!!
entries.translation: Vou com tudo! É bom estar pronto!!

entries.source: Is that the best you've got?

Yeah, you'll catch me... in your
dreams!!
entries.translation:
É, vai me pegar...
nos seus sonhos!!

entries.source:
You better devote yourself to training!
HAHAHA!!
entries.translation:
É melhor se dedicar ao treino!
HAHAHA!!

entries.source:
Never underestimate the powers of a
pervy old Sannin.
entries.translation:
Nunca subestime os poderes de
um velho Sannin tarado.

entries.source:
Well... It's time to bring you back to
the village.
entries.translation:
Bem... Hora de levar você
de volta à vila.

entries.source:
It was an impulse! I promise I'll never
peep again! Please forgive me!
entries.translation:
Foi por impulso! Prometo nunca
mais espiar! Por favor, me perdoe!

entries.source:
W...when you put it like that... I'm not
sure what to do...
entries.translation:
Q... Quando fala assim...
Não sei o que fazer...

entries.source:
From now on, I'll be good and virtuous!
Just let me off the hook this once!
entries.translation:
De agora em diante, serei bondoso e virtuoso!
Me livre dessa só desta vez!

entries.source:
Ehem... Are you sure you'll keep that
promise?
entries.translation:
Ahem... Vai mesmo cumprir
essa promessa?

entries.source:
Okay then. I'll let you go this one
time.
entries.translation:
Certo. Vou deixar você ir
só desta vez.

entries.source: Ah! Naruto! You have a heart of gold!
entries.translation: Ah! Naruto! Você tem um coração de ouro!

entries.source:
Okay, I'll be going, but you better do a lot
of soul-searching!
entries.translation:
Certo, vou indo, mas trate de
refletir bastante sobre isso!

entries.source: I think he's turned over a new leaf.
entries.translation: Acho que ele mudou de verdade.

entries.source:
You're right. His hunting instinct and
combat techniques are improving.
entries.translation:
Tem razão. O instinto de caça e
as técnicas de combate estão melhorando.

entries.source:
But he's far from being a full-fledged
ninja. We need to train him well.
entries.translation:
Mas ainda está longe de ser um ninja
completo. Precisamos treiná-lo bem.

entries.source:
About that promise you made to
Naruto... Are you really going to quit
peeping?
entries.translation:
Aquela promessa que fez ao
Naruto... Vai mesmo
parar de espiar?

entries.source:
Hm? What promise? It's hard to remember
things when you're as old as me.
entries.translation:
Hm? Que promessa? É difícil lembrar
das coisas na minha idade.

entries.source:
Huh. They say a sneeze means
someone's talking about you...
entries.translation:
Hã. Dizem que espirrar significa
que estão falando de você...

entries.source:
Jiraiya is still on the loose! Use the
map to help you find him!
entries.translation:
Jiraiya continua à solta! Use o
mapa para encontrá-lo!

entries.source:
What are you three sensei doing
gathered together?
entries.translation:
O que vocês três professores
estão fazendo juntos?

entries.source: Haha, just a little fun and games.
entries.translation: Haha, só nos divertindo um pouco.

entries.source:
It's not a game, Anko. It's a
simulation.
entries.translation:
Não é brincadeira, Anko.
É uma simulação.

entries.source:
Team members can't always be together.
For some missions, they have to work
with members of other teams.
entries.translation:
Os integrantes de um time nem sempre
podem ficar juntos. Em certas missões,
precisam trabalhar com outros times.

entries.source:
So we're trying to plan ahead for just
such an eventuality.
entries.translation:
Então estamos nos preparando
para essa possibilidade.

entries.source:
In other words, we're trying to come up
with the best combination of members
from different teams.
entries.translation:
Em outras palavras, tentamos achar
a melhor combinação de integrantes
de times diferentes.

entries.source:
Hmm, so did you come up with any good
combinations?
entries.translation:
Hmm, e acharam alguma
combinação boa?

entries.source:
We haven't found a suitable guinea pig...
An opponent we can use to test how
the new team works in action.
entries.translation:
Não encontramos uma cobaia adequada...
Um adversário para testar como
o novo time age em combate.

entries.source:
Hmm. In that case, I don't mind
being the opponent.
entries.translation:
Hmm. Nesse caso, posso
ser o adversário.

entries.source: Really!? Well, it's worth a shot, right!?
entries.translation: Sério?! Vale a tentativa, não é?!

entries.source:
Thanks. That'd really help us out,
Naruto.
entries.translation:
Obrigado. Vai nos ajudar muito,
Naruto.

entries.source:
I don't mind. Whoever they are,
I'll beat 'em anyway!
entries.translation:
Tudo bem. Não importa quem seja,
vou vencer de qualquer jeito!

entries.source:
This should be interesting. Okay,
let's get started!
entries.translation:
Vai ser interessante. Certo,
vamos começar!

entries.source:
I see... That seems to be an effective
combination.
Yeah. That kid seems to be the key.
entries.translation: É. Aquele garoto parece ser a chave.

entries.source:
(Ugh... I was trying to show them
that I'm the strongest...)
entries.translation:
(Urgh... Eu queria mostrar
que sou o mais forte...)

entries.source: Poor guy, He looks a little depressed.

Hey, there's no need to get down on
yourself ...

Aaah!! I need to train! Train and
train!!
entries.translation:
Aaah!! Preciso treinar!
Treinar e treinar!!

entries.source: I need to get better and stronger!!
entries.translation: Preciso melhorar e ficar mais forte!!

entries.source: Hm... Keep up the good work.

Getting right back up after a defeat is one
of your best traits, Naruto.
entries.translation:
Se levantar logo depois de perder é
uma das suas qualidades, Naruto.

entries.source:
Let's see... Who should we put in a
combination next.
Hah! No combination's a match for me!

It seems like... We may have miscalculated
a bit.
entries.translation:
Parece que... erramos
um pouco nos cálculos.

entries.source:
Guess that shows you which ninja is
the key to any combination!
entries.translation:
Isso mostra qual ninja é
a chave de qualquer combinação!

entries.source:
(Well, well... I never thought he had
come so far...)
entries.translation:
(Ora, ora... Não achei que ele
tivesse evoluído tanto...)

entries.source:
Hahahah! Did you see that, Anko sensei?
I'm pretty good, aren't I?
entries.translation:
Hahahah! Viu só, Anko-sensei?
Eu sou bom, não sou?

entries.source:
We've learned a lot today thanks to you,
Naruto.
entries.translation:
Aprendemos muito hoje graças a você,
Naruto.

entries.source: Put another X in the victory column!
entries.translation: Mais uma vitória para a conta!

entries.source:
Guess we'll have to try regrouping
members.
entries.translation:
Acho que teremos que reagrupar
os integrantes.

entries.source:
Yikes! Thanks to you, I have to
rethink the combinations all over again.
entries.translation:
Puxa! Por sua causa, vou ter
que repensar todas as combinações.

entries.source: So this is where you guys are.
entries.translation: Então é aqui que vocês estão.

entries.source:
I heard you're looking for a match
against the Leaf genin.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que procuram uma luta
contra os genins da Folha.

entries.source:
That's right, against the toughest ones
of them all.
entries.translation:
Isso mesmo, contra os mais
fortes de todos.

entries.source:
Since we've come all this way, we wanted
to get an idea of the Hidden Leaf's
abilities.
entries.translation:
Já que viemos até aqui, queremos
ter uma ideia das habilidades
da Folha.

entries.source:
So tell us, do you have any idea which
team is the best?
entries.translation:
Então diga: faz ideia de qual
time é o melhor?

entries.source:
(I wonder which team's the strongest...
Team Guy... Team Kurenai...
or Team Asuma...?)
entries.translation:
(Qual será o time mais forte...
Time Guy... Time Kurenai...
ou Time Asuma...?)

entries.source: (I've fought them all, more than once...)
entries.translation: (Já enfrentei todos, mais de uma vez...)

entries.source:
What the heck is this kid doing?
Is he just gonna stand there thinking
all day?
entries.translation:
O que esse garoto está fazendo?
Vai ficar aí pensando
o dia inteiro?

entries.source:
Kankuro, we're wasting our time here.
Let's go ask someone else.
entries.translation:
Kankuro, estamos perdendo tempo.
Vamos perguntar a outro.

entries.source: Uh, huh? Where did they go?

I got it! The strongest team is us,
Squad 7!
entries.translation:
Já sei! O time mais forte
é o nosso, o Time 7!

entries.source:
That's right! And I, Naruto Uzumaki, am
the strongest of them all!
entries.translation:
Isso mesmo! E eu, Naruto Uzumaki,
sou o mais forte de todos!

entries.source:
That's convenient. So let's
have a match right now.
entries.translation:
Que conveniente. Então vamos
lutar agora mesmo.

entries.source: Okay. I'll probably beat you, though.

Hehe! We'll see. We officially challenge
the mighty Naruto Uzumaki to a match!
entries.translation:
Hehe! Vamos ver. Desafiamos oficialmente
o poderoso Naruto Uzumaki para uma luta!

entries.source: You got it, no problem! Bring it on!

Naruto Uzumaki as an opponent...
This could be interesting...
entries.translation:
Naruto Uzumaki como adversário...
Pode ser interessante...

entries.source:
What was that...? And YOU'RE the
strongest of them all?
entries.translation:
O que foi aquilo...? E VOCÊ
é o mais forte de todos?

entries.source:
We're wasting our time fighting a guy
like that.
entries.translation:
Estamos perdendo tempo lutando
contra um cara desses.

entries.source:
Now you know. I'm the strongest of all
the genin in the Hidden Leaf Village!
entries.translation:
Agora sabem. Sou o mais forte de
todos os genins da Vila Oculta da Folha!

entries.source:
I must admit... I enjoyed that fight...
Thank you...
entries.translation:
Preciso admitir... Gostei da luta...
Obrigado...

entries.source:
Hehehe! Let's do it again sometime soon,
Gaara!
entries.translation:
Hehehe! Vamos lutar de novo
qualquer hora, Gaara!

entries.source: It's a deal. I'm looking forward to it.

(Huh... I don't like losing, but as long as
Gaara's happy, I can live with it.)
entries.translation:
(Hã... Não gosto de perder, mas,
se Gaara está feliz, posso aceitar.)

entries.source: Someday I may even... like you...
entries.translation: Um dia talvez eu até... goste de você...

entries.source:
That's a surprise. I've never heard Gaara
salute an opponent like that before.
entries.translation:
Que surpresa. Nunca ouvi Gaara
elogiar um adversário assim.

entries.source:
As long as Gaara's happy, it's okay with
us.
entries.translation:
Se Gaara está feliz,
para nós está tudo bem.

entries.source:
Iruka sensei and Kakashi sensei! What
are you two doing together?
entries.translation:
Iruka-sensei e Kakashi-sensei!
O que fazem juntos?

entries.source:
I wanted his thoughts on the future of
the Ninja Academy.
entries.translation:
Queria a opinião dele sobre
o futuro da Academia Ninja.

entries.source:
Hmm. Is Kakashi sensei really much
help? He always seems so, you know,
moody and kind of out of it.
entries.translation:
Hmm. Kakashi-sensei ajuda
mesmo? Ele sempre parece, sabe,
mal-humorado e meio distraído.

entries.source:
*Sigh* You should know better by now...
Actually, Kakashi is very popular with
the Ninja Academy students.
entries.translation:
*Suspiro* Você já devia saber...
Na verdade, Kakashi é muito popular
entre os alunos da Academia Ninja.

entries.source:
It's easy to see why the students adore him.
He's incredibly strong, for one thing.
entries.translation:
É fácil entender por que os alunos o adoram.
Para começar, é incrivelmente forte.

entries.source: Stop it, you're making me blush...

But there are a lot of other strong ninja
besides me. The Third Hokage, Master
Jiraiya, and even Guy.
entries.translation:
Mas há muitos outros ninjas fortes.
O Terceiro Hokage, Mestre
Jiraiya e até Guy.

entries.source:
Come to think of it, Grandma Tsunade is
pretty awesome, too.
entries.translation:
Pensando bem, a vovó Tsunade
também é incrível.

entries.source:
The peace we enjoy today is due to all
the extraordinary ninja who protect
the Hidden Leaf Village.
entries.translation:
A paz de hoje se deve a todos
os ninjas extraordinários que
protegem a Vila Oculta da Folha.

entries.source:
Hey, Kakashi sensei! Just how strong
are Super Bushy-Brow sensei,
Pervy Sage, and the others?
entries.translation:
Ei, Kakashi-sensei! Qual é a força
do Super-Sobrancelhudo, do
Sábio Tarado e dos outros?

entries.source:
Hey, Kakashi sensei! Just how strong are
Grandma Tsunade and Pervy Sage and
the others?
entries.translation:
Ei, Kakashi-sensei! Qual é a força
da vovó Tsunade, do Sábio Tarado
e dos outros?

entries.source:
I mean, how do you measure something
like that?
entries.translation:
Quer dizer, como se mede
uma coisa dessas?

entries.source:
Well... Let me put it this way and maybe
you'll understand.
entries.translation:
Bem... Vou explicar de um jeito
que talvez você entenda.

entries.source:
Wow... I got these images of super strong
ninja in my head.
entries.translation:
Nossa... Vejo imagens de ninjas
superfortes na minha cabeça.

entries.source:
Haha... Are you feeling intimidated by
them?
entries.translation:
Haha... Está se sentindo
intimidado por eles?

entries.source:
Now you have an idea of how incredibly
powerful they are.
entries.translation:
Agora tem uma ideia do quanto
eles são poderosos.

entries.source:
(...At this rate, I'll never be at Kakashi
sensei's level even if I train for years
and years...)
entries.translation:
(...Nesse ritmo, nunca vou chegar
ao nível de Kakashi-sensei, mesmo
treinando por anos e anos...)

entries.source:
If you train hard, you can be like Kakashi,
some day... But getting there will be
a long, hard journey.
entries.translation:
Se treinar muito, um dia pode
ser como Kakashi... Mas chegar lá
será uma jornada longa e difícil.

entries.source:
They put a lot of effort into getting as
strong as they are. I'd like to see you
become just like them.
entries.translation:
Eles se esforçaram muito para
ficar tão fortes. Quero ver você
se tornar como eles.

entries.source:
Ohhh...? Does that mean you doubt
it's possible?
entries.translation:
Ohhh...? Isso significa que
duvida que seja possível?

entries.source:
When I think that if I just train hard,
put my mind into it, and get lots of
experience...
entries.translation:
Quando penso que, se eu treinar muito,
me dedicar e ganhar bastante
experiência...

entries.source:
I can be like Kakashi sensei, or
Pervy Sage, or Iruka sensei one day...
Man, that's exciting!
entries.translation:
Um dia posso ser como Kakashi-sensei,
o Sábio Tarado ou Iruka-sensei...
Cara, é empolgante!

entries.source:
Huh... Do you have any idea how much
suffering Kakashi and the rest of them
went through to get where they are?
entries.translation:
Hã... Faz ideia do quanto
Kakashi e os outros sofreram
para chegar aonde estão?

entries.source:
No need to worry. It's working just
fine.
entries.translation:
Não se preocupe. Está
funcionando muito bem.

entries.source:
Once he sees a goal, he'll head straight
for it no matter what... with a speed and
tenacity that'd put you and I to shame.
entries.translation:
Quando vê um objetivo, ele corre
direto para ele, com uma velocidade
e persistência que nos envergonham.

entries.source:
He'll do whatever it takes to get stronger,
to get better. That's the Naruto Uzumaki
we both know.
entries.translation:
Ele faz o que for preciso para ficar
mais forte, para melhorar. Esse é
o Naruto Uzumaki que conhecemos.

entries.source:
Kakashi... I'm counting on you to look
after him.
entries.translation:
Kakashi... Conto com você
para cuidar dele.

entries.source:
The truth is, I'll only be guiding him
along the way. The rest he'll do on his
own.
entries.translation:
Na verdade, só vou guiá-lo
pelo caminho. O resto ele
fará sozinho.

entries.source:
Frankly, I'm as excited as he is about
this journey he's on.
entries.translation:
Francamente, estou tão animado
quanto ele com essa jornada.

entries.source:
All right!! I'm going to train like no one's
ever trained!
entries.translation:
Muito bem!! Vou treinar como
ninguém jamais treinou!

entries.source:
It's good to train, but don't do anything
dangerous, Naruto.
entries.translation:
Treinar é bom, mas não faça
nada perigoso, Naruto.

entries.source:
I wonder what kind of training I should try
next... Hmm...
entries.translation:
Que treino devo tentar
agora... Hmm...

entries.source:
While hearing Kakashi sensei speak,
their images filled Naruto's mind.
entries.translation:
Ao ouvir Kakashi-sensei falar,
aquelas imagens encheram a mente de Naruto.

entries.source:
Pervy Sage! Why do you look so spaced
out?
entries.translation:
Sábio Tarado! Por que está
tão distraído?

entries.source:
Oh... I was just pondering the
future.
entries.translation:
Ah... Só estava pensando
no futuro.

entries.source:
There are those want to take over the
Leaf Village... and others are after you.
We have many enemies in this world.
entries.translation:
Há quem queira dominar a Vila
da Folha... e outros atrás de você.
Temos muitos inimigos neste mundo.

entries.source:
Someday we are going to have to face
them, and I must stay vigilant until
that day comes.
entries.translation:
Um dia teremos que enfrentá-los,
e preciso ficar vigilante até
esse dia chegar.

entries.source:
You mean like that Itachi Uchiha,
and...?
entries.translation:
Está falando daquele Itachi Uchiha
e...?

entries.source:
At some point, you're going to have to
face them too.
entries.translation:
Em algum momento, você também
vai ter que enfrentá-los.

entries.source:
(I wonder... Am I going to be up for it,
when it comes...?)
entries.translation:
(Será que... vou estar preparado
quando chegar a hora...?)

entries.source:
(Just thinking about them is making him
tremble...)
entries.translation:
(Só de pensar neles,
ele já está tremendo...)

entries.source:
(And no wonder... They're fierce
opponents to face...)
entries.translation:
(Não é para menos... São
adversários terríveis...)

entries.source: I won't lose... I CAN'T lose...
entries.translation: Não vou perder... Não POSSO perder...

entries.source:
Don't rush it. Take your time.
Strengthen yourself slowly, but surely.
entries.translation:
Não tenha pressa. Vá com calma.
Fortaleça-se devagar, mas com firmeza.

entries.source:
I don't care how strong and scary
they are...
entries.translation:
Não me importa o quanto sejam
fortes e assustadores...

entries.source:
I... I'm a Hidden Leaf Ninja and I will
not lose!
entries.translation:
Eu... Sou um ninja da Folha
e não vou perder!

entries.source:
That's why I gotta keep on training and
training, and get to be as strong as I
can be. Right, Pervy Sage?!
entries.translation:
Por isso preciso continuar treinando
e ficar o mais forte que puder.
Não é, Sábio Tarado?!

entries.source:
(Huh... What confidence, even knowing
who he's up against...)
entries.translation:
(Hã... Quanta confiança, mesmo
sabendo quem vai enfrentar...)

entries.source:
You make me feel better about our
future! But I hope you're ready for the
training to come...
entries.translation:
Você me deixa mais tranquilo com
nosso futuro! Mas espero que esteja
