I'm one of the strong ones.
entries.translation:
E eu sobrevivo, é claro.
Porque sou um dos fortes.

entries.source:
So I lost to my cousin Neji... But
I think I've gained some confidence from
it. I think...
entries.translation:
Perdi para meu primo Neji...
Mas acho que ganhei um pouco
de confiança. Eu acho...

entries.source:
Shino's the last one from my squad still
in it. I had a feeling that this would
happen.
entries.translation:
Shino é o último da minha equipe
no exame. Eu tinha a sensação
de que isso aconteceria.

entries.source:
But what I never imagined was that YOU'D
still be in it! I never thought that you
could manage to make it to the finals...
entries.translation:
Mas nunca imaginei que VOCÊ
continuaria nele! Não achei
que chegaria à final...

entries.source:
The exam section I'm in charge of is
finally over. Now I can take some time
to relax on my own.
entries.translation:
A parte do exame de que cuido
finalmente acabou. Agora
posso relaxar um pouco.

entries.source:
Hey, Naruto! I heard you made it to the
finals of the Chunin Exam!
entries.translation:
Ei, Naruto! Soube que você chegou
à final do Exame Chunin!

entries.source:
You're on your way to becoming a
chunin! Hah! Fancy that!
entries.translation:
Está a caminho de virar chunin!
Ha! Quem diria!

entries.source:
Naruto, I heard you're still in the
Chunin Exam! That's awesome!
entries.translation:
Naruto, soube que você continua
no Exame Chunin! Demais!

entries.source:
I knew you could do it, since you're my
ninja rival! I'm gonna be like you when
I grow up!
entries.translation:
Sabia que conseguiria, afinal você
é meu rival ninja! Quero
ser como você quando crescer!

entries.source:
Now, show me the fruits of your
training.
entries.translation:
Agora, mostre os frutos
do seu treinamento.

entries.source:
(I've got a bad feeling... Could it be
that guy might make a move to attack us
...?)
entries.translation:
(Estou com um mau pressentimento...
Será que aquele homem está
prestes a nos atacar...?)

entries.source:
You’re really trying hard, right, Naruto?
I’m looking forward to you becoming
Hokage.
entries.translation:
Você está se esforçando muito,
né, Naruto? Quero ver você
se tornar Hokage.

entries.source:
I've been seeing a lot of ninja around
here. Is something going down?
entries.translation:
Tenho visto muitos ninjas
por aqui. Há algo acontecendo?

entries.source:
Is it one of those "field days" or
something? Oh, it's not...?
entries.translation:
É algum daqueles eventos
esportivos? Ah, não é...?

entries.source:
My best friend got injured during a
mission... I'm heading out to the
hospital to pay him a visit.
entries.translation:
Meu melhor amigo se feriu
numa missão... Vou ao hospital
fazer uma visita.

entries.source:
There's something eerie about those ninja
from the Hidden Sound Village.
entries.translation:
Há algo estranho naqueles ninjas
da Vila Oculta do Som.

entries.source:
It's like, I can never tell what they're
thinking. They never show any
expression.
entries.translation:
Nunca dá para saber o que
estão pensando. Não demonstram
nenhuma expressão.

entries.source:
Everyone’s talking about a book called
“Make-Out Paradise”.
entries.translation:
Todos estão falando de um livro
chamado “Paraíso da Pegação”.

entries.source:
Even I saw it the other day, and that's
what you call pretty wild stuff.
entries.translation:
Dei uma olhada outro dia.
Aquilo é bem pesado.

entries.source:
I may not look it, but I used to be good
friends with the Third Hokage. We talked
and talked over tea...
entries.translation:
Pode não parecer, mas eu era
muito amigo do Terceiro Hokage.
Conversávamos muito tomando chá...

entries.source:
He really loves this village. I could
tell from the way he used to talk.
entries.translation:
Ele ama muito esta vila.
Dava para perceber pelo
jeito como falava.

entries.source:
I see the Chunin Exam is progressing
well. Everyone seems very focused.
entries.translation:
Vejo que o Exame Chunin
vai bem. Todos parecem
muito concentrados.

entries.source:
No matter how strong the enemy is, never
ever give up, young man.
entries.translation:
Não importa a força do inimigo,
nunca desista, jovem.

entries.source:
Difficult ordeals are what make a
ninja stronger. Please don't give up.
entries.translation:
As provações tornam um ninja
mais forte. Não desista.

entries.source:
I was on my way home, but I got
so lost in reminiscence that I
nearly wandered out of the village!
entries.translation:
Eu ia para casa, mas fiquei
tão perdido nas lembranças
que quase saí da vila!

entries.source:
I finally managed to find my way back.
Now I just have to remember where my
house is.
entries.translation:
Finalmente achei o caminho de volta.
Agora só preciso lembrar
onde fica minha casa.

entries.source:
I'm playing hide-and-seek with
Konohamaru, but I can't find him
anywhere!
entries.translation:
Estou brincando de esconde-esconde
com o Konohamaru, mas
não o acho em lugar nenhum!

entries.source:
Only the Third Hokage's grandson could
do! He'll make a perfect rival!
entries.translation:
Só podia ser o neto do Terceiro!
Será um rival perfeito!

entries.source:
We're all going out to eat BBQ today.
I'm so happy.
entries.translation:
Hoje vamos todos comer churrasco.
Estou tão feliz.

entries.source:
I just went to the Insect Shop. Aren't
beetles the coolest bugs in the world?
entries.translation:
Fui à Loja de Insetos. Besouros
não são os insetos mais legais?

entries.source:
I got to see the Great Stone Faces from
up close. That was so cool!
entries.translation:
Vi os Rostos de Pedra de perto.
Foi muito legal!

entries.source:
I wonder how it feels to have your face
carved into rock like that. Now I wanna
be Hokage someday too!
entries.translation:
Como deve ser ter o rosto
esculpido na pedra? Agora
também quero virar Hokage!

entries.source:
The ninja are acting strange lately.
They seem a little tense or something.
entries.translation:
Os ninjas estão estranhos
ultimamente. Parecem
meio tensos.

entries.source:
I heard the Kazekage is visiting from
the Hidden Sand Village. I wonder what
type of person he is.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que o Kazekage veio visitar
da Vila Oculta da Areia.
Como será que ele é?

entries.source:
Asuma is so cool and wild... But I can’t
give up Kakashi.
entries.translation:
Asuma é tão legal e selvagem...
Mas não consigo largar o Kakashi.

entries.source:
I want to date a jonin. He’d be sure
to protect me!
entries.translation:
Quero namorar um jonin.
Ele certamente me protegeria!

entries.source:
I don't like the feel of that wind. It
makes me think something's about to
happen...
entries.translation:
Não gostei desse vento.
Parece que alguma coisa
está para acontecer...

entries.source: Make sure to be extra careful.

Ino told me not to cry so quickly,
because a girl's tears should be
saved as a final weapon.
entries.translation:
Ino disse para eu não chorar fácil.
As lágrimas de uma garota
devem ser sua arma final.

entries.source:
She didn't tell me what that meant. Do
you know what she was talking about?
entries.translation:
Ela não explicou o que isso quer
dizer. Você entendeu?

entries.source:
There's supposed to be lots of flowers
growing in the outskirts of the village,
but Mom says I'm not allowed there.
entries.translation:
Dizem que há muitas flores
nos arredores da vila, mas
a mamãe não me deixa ir lá.

entries.source:
Too bad... I was planning to pick a
whole bunch of flowers and surprise her
with them.
entries.translation:
Que pena... Eu queria colher
um monte e fazer
uma surpresa para ela.

entries.source:
My dad told me not to go outside too
much. No one ever told me stuff like
that before.
entries.translation:
Meu pai mandou eu não sair muito.
Nunca tinham me dito
uma coisa dessas.

entries.source:
There's this guy named Kiba Inuzuka who
smells like a dog.
entries.translation:
Tem um tal de Kiba Inuzuka
que tem cheiro de cachorro.

entries.source:
Maybe some cologne would make him more
popular with girls. He seems nice and
all.
entries.translation:
Talvez um perfume o tornasse
mais popular com as garotas.
Ele parece legal.

entries.source:
I went to a parent-teacher conference at
the Ninja Academy, and they said my
child plays too many tricks.
entries.translation:
Fui à reunião de pais na Academia
Ninja. Disseram que meu filho
faz travessuras demais.

entries.source:
But "let kids be kids" has been my
philosophy! Hahahaha!
entries.translation:
Mas minha filosofia é deixar
a criança ser criança! Hahaha!

entries.source:
Nara's boy... that "Shikamaru"? He's
always been so laid-back.
entries.translation:
O filho dos Nara... O Shikamaru?
Ele sempre foi tão sossegado.

entries.source:
The other day I saw him taking a nap.
How does he manage to be a ninja?
entries.translation:
Outro dia o vi tirando uma soneca.
Como ele consegue ser ninja?

entries.source:
*pant* *pant* I have to get home fast
and get my wallet. Can't believe I
forgot it!
entries.translation:
*Ofegante* Preciso chegar logo
em casa e pegar minha carteira.
Não acredito que a esqueci!

entries.source:
Now that the Chunin Exam is being held,
I've been seeing a lot of important
people from other countries.
entries.translation:
Com o Exame Chunin acontecendo,
tenho visto muita gente
importante de outros países.

entries.source:
I'm so nervous that my child's going to
make a careless mistake.
entries.translation:
Estou com medo de meu filho
cometer algum erro bobo.

entries.source:
We were busy on missions the whole time
you guys were taking the exam.
entries.translation:
Ficamos ocupados com missões
enquanto vocês faziam o exame.

entries.source:
And they were all D-Ranked missions!
What a bore that was!
entries.translation:
E eram todas de nível D!
Que tédio!

entries.source:
I failed the Chunin Exam AGAIN! That
makes three in a row...
entries.translation:
Reprovei no Exame Chunin DE NOVO!
Três vezes seguidas...

entries.source: I'll have to apologize to my sensei.
entries.translation:
Vou ter que pedir desculpas
ao meu sensei.

entries.source:
The other day I saw a Sand Ninja and
Sound Ninja whispering about something.
entries.translation:
Outro dia vi um ninja da Areia
e um do Som cochichando.

entries.source:
I didn't know those villages were on
good terms.
entries.translation:
Não sabia que aquelas vilas
se davam bem.

entries.source:
Ha haa! C-Ranked, you know! My team is
going on a C-Ranked mission next time!
entries.translation:
Haha! Nível C! Minha equipe
vai fazer uma missão
de nível C na próxima vez!

entries.source:
This is where I come in! Look at me! I
can't stop shaking!
entries.translation:
É a minha hora! Olhe só!
Não consigo parar de tremer!

entries.source:
I just saw the Anbu Black Ops. What are
they doing?
entries.translation:
Acabei de ver a ANBU.
O que será que estão fazendo?

entries.source:
They are under the direct supervision of
Lord Hokage. Then, they're working under
his orders...?
entries.translation:
Eles respondem diretamente
ao Hokage. Então devem
estar cumprindo ordens dele...

entries.source:
I'm finally back from my mission. And it
was a tough one.
entries.translation:
Finalmente voltei da missão.
E foi bem difícil.

entries.source:
But now I've got a little time off, so
I'll go out and have some fun! Haha!
entries.translation:
Agora tenho uma folga.
Vou sair para me divertir! Haha!

entries.source:
I was ordered to strengthen the village
patrol. I'm guessing the extra
security's needed for the final round...
entries.translation:
Mandaram reforçar a patrulha
da vila. Deve ser por causa
da segurança da final...

entries.source:
There are some feudal lords from other
countries coming to watch the final
round, but... umm.
entries.translation:
Alguns senhores feudais de outros
países virão assistir
à final, mas... Hmm.

entries.source:
This year's new recruits are
surprisingly talented.
entries.translation:
Os novatos deste ano são
surpreendentemente talentosos.

entries.source:
Especially that sole survivor of the
Uchiha Clan... He's got some smart
moves.
entries.translation:
Principalmente o último
sobrevivente do clã Uchiha...
Ele sabe lutar muito bem.

entries.source: A ninja told me to go home.
entries.translation: Um ninja mandou eu ir para casa.

entries.source: What? But I still wanna play.
entries.translation: O quê? Mas ainda quero brincar.

entries.source:
Yeah, but...but if I don't do what he
says...I'll get yelled at again....
entries.translation:
É, mas... Se eu não obedecer...
Vou levar bronca de novo...

entries.source:
Oh come on, don't cry! Well...There's no
choice...
entries.translation:
Ah, qual é, não chore!
Bem... Não temos escolha...

entries.source:
I never thought you'd make it this far in
the Chunin Exam. Seems I underestimated
you.
entries.translation:
Nunca pensei que você fosse tão longe
no Exame Chunin. Parece
que eu o subestimei.

entries.source:
The Honorable Grandson really looks up to
you, so you better not disappoint him!
entries.translation:
O honorável neto admira você.
É bom não decepcioná-lo!

entries.source:
I thought you just became a genin. Now
you're gonna be a chunin?
entries.translation:
Achei que você tinha acabado
de virar genin. Já vai
virar chunin?

entries.source:
Oh, not yet huh? But Konohamaru said
you're gonna be one for sure!
entries.translation:
Ah, ainda não? Mas o Konohamaru
disse que você vai conseguir!

entries.source: Hey Naruto! I'll be cheering for you!
entries.translation: Ei, Naruto! Vou torcer por você!

entries.source: I know you'll make chunin! Do your best!
entries.translation:
Sei que vai virar chunin!
Dê o seu melhor!

entries.source:
The Chunin Exam? Wow, keep up
the good work, Naruto.
entries.translation:
O Exame Chunin? Uau,
continue assim, Naruto.

entries.source:
Eat lots of Ichiraku ramen and
put some meat on those bones!
entries.translation:
Coma bastante lámen do Ichiraku
para ganhar força!

entries.source:
I can't believe my hottest item's all
sold out already...Doh! What was I
thinking!?
entries.translation:
Não acredito que meu produto
mais vendido já acabou...
Droga! Onde eu estava com a cabeça!?

entries.source:
I'll just have to put somethin' out in
it's place for now...*sigh*... Business
isn't going so great this month...
entries.translation:
Vou ter que pôr outra coisa
no lugar... *Suspiro* Os negócios
não vão bem este mês...

entries.source:
Never is easy marketing a new product, I
suppose... Took me all night to come up
with though...
entries.translation:
Vender um produto novo nunca
é fácil... E eu levei a noite
inteira para inventá-lo...

entries.source:
Got some new food pills! Same great
ingredients, super-sized! But only
that Akimichi kid seems to like 'em.
entries.translation:
Novas pílulas de ração! Mesmos
ingredientes, tamanho gigante!
Mas só aquele Akimichi gosta delas.

entries.source:
I can't believe so many rookies made it
to the finals this year. They must really
be good. It makes me proud as a graduate.
entries.translation:
Tantos novatos na final deste ano!
Eles devem ser bons mesmo.
Fico orgulhoso como ex-aluno.

entries.source:
Well... I finished the exam so quickly,
though...
entries.translation:
Bem... O meu exame acabou
tão depressa...

entries.source:
*sigh* I bombed the exam, just like I
thought I would.
entries.translation:
*Suspiro* Fui péssimo no exame,
como imaginei.

entries.source:
I was just causing problems for the other
two in my squad. It's kind of depressing,
really.
entries.translation:
Só atrapalhei os outros dois
da equipe. É bem
desanimador, na verdade.

entries.source: Hmm... Where was that shop again...?
entries.translation: Hmm... Onde era aquela loja mesmo...?

entries.source: Heehee! You're so full of energy.

The Leaf Village sure has a lot
of people in it.
entries.translation:
A Vila da Folha tem
muita gente mesmo.

entries.source:
What kinda game should I play
today?
I gotta get home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Preciso ir para casa fazer a lição.

entries.source:
I wanna be a ninja too,
an' do lots an' lots of missions!
entries.translation:
Quero ser ninja também
e fazer muitas missões!

entries.source:
My dad's coming back from his
mission real soon! Heheh,
I can't wait!
entries.translation:
Meu pai logo vai voltar
da missão! Hehe,
mal posso esperar!

entries.source:
I want to be a ninja, too...
Then I could protect my little sister!
entries.translation:
Quero ser ninja também...
Assim protegerei minha irmãzinha!

entries.source:
I saw the Hokage's house...
It's HUGE!
entries.translation:
Vi a casa do Hokage...
É ENORME!

entries.source:
The village sure is larger than
it used to be.
entries.translation:
A vila está bem maior
do que era antes.

entries.source:
I deeply respect the current Hokage,
but the First and Second Hokages
were simply amazing.
entries.translation:
Respeito muito o Hokage atual,
mas o Primeiro e o Segundo
eram incríveis.

entries.source:
I should go home.
My son's probably worried.
entries.translation:
É melhor eu ir para casa.
Meu filho deve estar preocupado.

entries.source:
Hmm...?
Now where was I again...?

My goodness, if you aren't a
rambunctious little ninja.
entries.translation:
Nossa, que ninjinha
agitado você é.

entries.source:
Hm? Sorry, can it wait?
I'm really busy right now.
entries.translation:
Hm? Desculpe, pode esperar?
Estou muito ocupado agora.

entries.source:
When is my no-good loafer of a
husband going to be home!?
entries.translation:
Quando meu marido imprestável
vai voltar para casa!?

entries.source: I wonder what I should eat today.
entries.translation: O que será que vou comer hoje?

entries.source:
Finally, I get a break!
It's time for fun!
entries.translation:
Finalmente, uma folga!
Hora de me divertir!

entries.source:
Heheh, you're the new kid, ain'tcha?
Good luck!
entries.translation:
Hehe, você é o novato, né?
Boa sorte!

entries.source:
Hey! You keeping up the training?
Ninja must be ever diligent!
entries.translation:
Ei! Está treinando direito?
Um ninja deve se dedicar sempre!

entries.source:
My folks are always yelling at me to
make chunin already. You think I
haven't been trying!?
entries.translation:
Meus pais vivem cobrando que eu
vire chunin logo. Acham
que não estou tentando!?

entries.source:
My little brother wants to be a
ninja, too. For his sake, I can't
let myself lose.
entries.translation:
Meu irmãozinho também quer ser ninja.
Por ele, não posso
me dar ao luxo de perder.

entries.source:
Uh... I ate too much Ichiraku Ramen... I
can't eat any more...
entries.translation:
Ah... Comi demais no Ichiraku Ramen...
Não aguento mais...

entries.source:
Let's see, where will my next
mission take me...? Careful
preparation is key.
entries.translation:
Vamos ver, para onde minha próxima
missão me levará...?
É essencial me preparar bem.

entries.source:
Rats! I can't believe I failed
my mission...
entries.translation:
Droga! Não acredito
que falhei na missão...

entries.source:
The Uchiha clan, the Hyuga clan...
Some real big names in the
latest crop of genin.
entries.translation:
O clã Uchiha, o clã Hyuga...
Há nomes importantes entre
os novos genin.

entries.source:
It's rare enough that I get some
time off... Think I'll take it easy.
entries.translation:
É tão raro eu ter uma folga...
Acho que vou descansar.

entries.source:
That was just awful... I'm sure glad
you're okay now.
entries.translation:
Aquilo foi horrível...
Ainda bem que você está bem.

entries.source:
By the way, have you seen Sasuke around?
I can't find him anywhere.
entries.translation:
Aliás, viu o Sasuke por aí?
Não consigo encontrá-lo.

entries.source:
A catastrophe could be on its way to the
Leaf Village.
entries.translation:
Uma catástrofe pode estar
a caminho da Vila da Folha.

entries.source:
I have to get stronger to repel such
things...!
entries.translation:
Preciso ficar mais forte
para impedir algo assim...!

entries.source:
Guy-sensei is going to put me through
special training to get me prepared for
upcoming events!
entries.translation:
Guy-sensei vai me dar um treino
especial para me preparar
para o que está por vir!

entries.source:
Just watch! I'll get stronger! That's a
promise!
entries.translation:
Pode esperar! Ficarei mais forte!
É uma promessa!

entries.source:
I had a bad feeling about that Temari
from the start. I just knew she was an
enemy.
entries.translation:
Tive um mau pressentimento sobre
aquela Temari desde o início.
Sabia que era uma inimiga.

entries.source:
A Hidden Leaf Village ninja must be
stronger! More passionate! Even tougher!
entries.translation:
Um ninja da Vila da Folha deve
ser mais forte! Mais dedicado!
Ainda mais resistente!

entries.source:
I will dedicate my heart and soul to
training Lee and the others!!
entries.translation:
Vou me dedicar de corpo e alma
a treinar Lee e os outros!!

entries.source:
Those Sand people had me suspicious from
the start, so it's no wonder they
betrayed us.
entries.translation:
Eu desconfiava do pessoal da Areia
desde o começo. Não me
surpreende que nos traíram.

entries.source:
Sheesh, if it's that much of a hassle, I
shouldn't have even bothered to
participate in the Chunin Exam.
entries.translation:
Poxa, se era tanta dor de cabeça,
nem devia ter participado
do Exame Chunin.

entries.source:
I haven't been able to go out for dinner
since that turmoil took place the other
day.
entries.translation:
Não consegui sair para jantar
desde aquela confusão
do outro dia.

entries.source:
The Hidden Sound Village will have to
pay for this! They're gonna learn that
grudges over food are serious business!
entries.translation:
A Vila Oculta do Som vai pagar!
Vão aprender que comida
é assunto sério!

entries.source:
My shop wasn’t affected by the
destruction of The Hidden Leaf
Village...
entries.translation:
Minha loja não foi afetada
pela destruição
da Vila da Folha...

entries.source:
I feel for those with lost or damaged
property, but thankfully I can carry on
my trade.
entries.translation:
Sinto por quem perdeu seus bens,
mas, felizmente, posso
continuar meu comércio.

entries.source:
That Orochimaru... I can't believe the
timing of his attack...
entries.translation:
Aquele Orochimaru... Não acredito
que escolheu aquela hora
para atacar...

entries.source:
I was shocked by that turmoil a while
back, but it's over now and not worth
crying over...
entries.translation:
Fiquei chocado com aquela confusão,
mas já passou. Não adianta
ficar lamentando...

entries.source:
Anyway, I can't believe you actually
beat Neji! What kinda sneaky moves did
you use to pull that off, huh?
entries.translation:
Aliás, não acredito que você
derrotou o Neji! Que truques
usou para conseguir, hein?

entries.source:
That battle with the puppet master
taught me quite a lot...
entries.translation:
A luta contra o mestre
de marionetes me ensinou muito...

entries.source:
Something can always be learned from any
battle, and I've grown stronger through
this.
entries.translation:
Toda batalha nos ensina algo.
Com essa, fiquei
ainda mais forte.

entries.source:
Oh, Naruto... You weren't hurt by the
recent turmoil... Right?
entries.translation:
Ah, Naruto... Você não se feriu
naquela confusão... Né?

entries.source:
Um, just let me know if... I mean... If
you're hurt, even a bit, I've got some
medicine, so...
entries.translation:
É... Me avise se... Quero dizer...
Se estiver ferido, mesmo
que só um pouco, tenho remédio...

entries.source:
The Third Hokage has passed away. He was
such a good person, it's not easy to
take.
entries.translation:
O Terceiro Hokage morreu.
Ele era tão bom.
É difícil aceitar.

entries.source:
But we can't let it drag us down. Get
all that sadness out of you right here
and now, okay?
entries.translation:
Mas não podemos nos abater.
Coloque toda essa tristeza
para fora agora, certo?

entries.source:
Orochimaru... I'll never forgive him for
this.
entries.translation:
Orochimaru... Nunca
vou perdoá-lo por isso.

entries.source:
Even if he is my former master, I’ll
finish him...!
entries.translation:
Mesmo sendo meu antigo mestre,
vou acabar com ele...!

entries.source:
You should have learned a valuable
lesson through that battle.
entries.translation:
Você deve ter aprendido
uma lição valiosa naquela luta.

entries.source:
Don't lose that big heart of yours.
It'll prove to be a valuable asset
someday.
entries.translation:
Não perca esse seu bom coração.
Um dia, ele será
muito importante.

entries.source:
Mister... I’m... sad, but... I’ll do my
best! Just watch me!
entries.translation:
Senhor... Estou... triste, mas...
Vou dar o meu melhor!
Pode esperar!

entries.source:
We've lost so many things in the
Destruction of the Hidden Leaf Village.
entries.translation:
Perdemos tantas coisas
na destruição da Vila da Folha.

entries.source:
But we've also gained a lot, and we
can't let those gains go to waste. Is
that clear?
entries.translation:
Mas também ganhamos muito.
Não podemos deixar isso
se perder. Entendeu?

entries.source:
The Third Hokage used to come here often,
too... I’m so lonely...
entries.translation:
O Terceiro Hokage também vinha
muito aqui... Sinto tanta falta...

entries.source:
I can't believe ninja from other
Nation's villages got all nuts in the
Leaf Village... That really spooked me!
entries.translation:
Não acredito que ninjas de outras
vilas atacaram a Folha...
Foi assustador!

entries.source:
I heard one of the Sannin was the
mastermind behind that turmoil that
broke out a while ago.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que um dos Sannin
estava por trás
daquela confusão.

entries.source:
Aren't the Sannin from the Leaf Village?
Why would they want to attack their own
village!?
entries.translation:
Os Sannin não são da Folha?
Por que atacariam
a própria vila!?

entries.source:
We're finally back to everyday life
here. This is exactly how a village
should function.
entries.translation:
Finalmente voltamos à rotina.
É assim que uma vila
deve funcionar.

entries.source:
The Chunin Exams Stadium has been off
limits ever since that incident.
entries.translation:
O estádio do Exame Chunin
está fechado desde o incidente.

entries.source:
I've left my stuff in there... I wonder
how I should go about getting it back...
entries.translation:
Deixei minhas coisas lá dentro...
Como vou recuperá-las...?

entries.source:
So the Third Hokage passed away... We've
lost a great man...
entries.translation:
Então o Terceiro Hokage morreu...
Perdemos um grande homem...

entries.source:
I was attacked by a Sand ninja, but a
man named Guy came to my rescue.
entries.translation:
Um ninja da Areia me atacou,
mas um homem chamado Guy
veio me salvar.

entries.source:
He was quite the fighter, that man... He
seemed to have a fire in his belly...!
entries.translation:
Ele era um grande lutador...
Parecia ter fogo
dentro de si...!

entries.source:
One look at my taijutsu would send the
ninja scrambling for cover way back
when.
entries.translation:
Antigamente, bastava ver meu
taijutsu para os ninjas
saírem correndo.

entries.source:
Hahaha! I'll bet I could still hold my
own against the younger crowd.
entries.translation:
Hahaha! Aposto que ainda
daria conta dos mais jovens.

entries.source:
I got lost and ended up outside the
village. Apparently something awful
happened while I was gone.
entries.translation:
Me perdi e acabei fora da vila.
Parece que houve algo terrível
enquanto eu estava fora.

entries.source:
Every now and then my senility comes in
handy.
entries.translation:
Às vezes, minha memória fraca
até ajuda.

entries.source:
I liked him a lot. He was really kind
and funny.
entries.translation:
Eu gostava muito dele.
Era tão gentil e engraçado.

entries.source:
My mom says it's still dangerous
outside, so she doesn't let me go out
much.
entries.translation:
Minha mãe diz que ainda está
perigoso lá fora e não
me deixa sair muito.

entries.source:
But it should be fine with all the ninja
protecting us, right?
entries.translation:
Mas está tudo bem com tantos
ninjas nos protegendo, né?

entries.source: I just saw an odd looking pair.
entries.translation: Acabei de ver uma dupla estranha.

entries.source:
They were all dressed in black...
It was frightening.
entries.translation:
Estavam vestidos de preto...
Deu medo.

entries.source:
The Ninja Academy's been closed for a
while now, and all the sensei are out on
missions.
entries.translation:
A Academia Ninja está fechada
há um tempo, e todos
os sensei saíram em missões.

entries.source:
And that means we've got tons of
homework to do. It's driving me crazy.
entries.translation:
Isso significa que temos
um monte de lição para fazer.
Está me deixando louco.

entries.source:
It was pretty rough for a while, but
we're finally able to get back to our
normal lives again.
entries.translation:
Foi bem difícil por um tempo,
mas finalmente voltamos
à vida normal.

entries.source:
We're finally allowed to leave the
village. Now I can go on trips to the
other villages.
entries.translation:
Finalmente podemos sair da vila.
Agora posso visitar
as outras vilas.

entries.source:
So I thought I'd head for the Hidden
Sound Village first, but they say
we can't go. Why not?
entries.translation:
Pensei em ir primeiro à Vila
Oculta do Som, mas disseram
que não podemos. Por quê?

entries.source:
I was supposed to be watching the
matches at the Chunin Exams Stadium, but
I ended up sleeping before noticing it.
entries.translation:
Eu ia assistir às lutas no estádio
do Exame Chunin, mas acabei
adormecendo sem perceber.

entries.source:
When I woke up the place was in tatters.
I wish somebody would tell me what
happened!
entries.translation:
Quando acordei, estava tudo destruído.
Queria que alguém me contasse
o que aconteceu!

entries.source:
This village just isn't the same since
the Third Hokage passed away.
entries.translation:
A vila não é mais a mesma
desde a morte do Terceiro Hokage.

entries.source:
We need to hurry up and decide on the
next Hokage to bring back stability.
entries.translation:
Precisamos escolher logo o próximo
Hokage para recuperar a estabilidade.

entries.source:
I saw a really, really BIG frog hopping
around in the forest!
entries.translation:
Vi um sapo MUITO, muito grande
pulando pela floresta!

entries.source:
It was fighting with some kind of tanuki
animal! I was really amazed!
entries.translation:
Ele lutava contra um tipo de tanuki!
Fiquei impressionado!

entries.source:
My dad got hurt and he's in the
hospital. I'm on my way to see him now.
entries.translation:
Meu pai se feriu e está no hospital.
Estou indo visitá-lo agora.

entries.source:
If I take him a whole bunch of flowers,
he can leave the hospital early, right?
entries.translation:
Se eu levar muitas flores,
ele sai do hospital mais cedo, né?

entries.source:
Were the Sand Ninja bad people? They
didn't seem that way to me...
entries.translation:
Os ninjas da Areia eram maus?
Não me pareceram assim...

entries.source:
Because one of them apologized for what
happened when he passed in front of me.
entries.translation:
Um deles pediu desculpas
pelo que aconteceu quando
passou por mim.

entries.source:
Oh, you're Naruto Uzumaki, right? I saw
you fighting with Hyuga.
entries.translation:
Ah, você é Naruto Uzumaki, né?
Vi sua luta contra o Hyuga.

entries.source:
Well... You're actually good. Maybe I
was wrong about you...just a little,
anyway.
entries.translation:
Bem... Você até que é bom.
Talvez eu estivesse errado
sobre você... Só um pouco.

entries.source:
Prices have gone up since that trouble
took place the other day.
entries.translation:
Os preços subiram desde
aquela confusão do outro dia.

entries.source:
*sigh* Our biggest problem now is
figuring out how to manage our food
properly.
entries.translation:
*Suspiro* Nosso maior problema
agora é como administrar
a comida direito.

entries.source:
My boy hasn't come home for a while now.
He's got his hands full with all them
missions and such.
entries.translation:
Meu filho não vem para casa
há um tempo. Está cheio
de missões e tudo mais.

entries.source:
Isn't it common sense to come home first
whenever you come back to the village?
entries.translation:
Não é óbvio que deve vir para casa
primeiro quando volta à vila?

entries.source:
First the Nine-Tailed Fox attacked us,
and then the destruction of the Hidden
Leaf Village. When do we get peace?
entries.translation:
Primeiro a Nove Caudas nos atacou,
depois veio a destruição da Folha.
Quando teremos paz?

entries.source:
We were ordered to evacuate when the
village was going through all that
trouble.
entries.translation:
Recebemos ordens de evacuar
durante toda aquela
confusão na vila.

entries.source:
But when we heard the word "evacuate,"
we panicked and didn't know what to do.
entries.translation:
Mas, quando ouvimos “evacuar”,
entramos em pânico e
não sabíamos o que fazer.

entries.source:
Kakashi-sensei helped me out when we
were attacked by those Sound freaks.
entries.translation:
Kakashi-sensei me ajudou quando
aqueles malucos do Som atacaram.

entries.source:
I'm still too weak. Just gotta get more
training in, that's all.
entries.translation:
Ainda sou fraco demais.
Só preciso treinar mais.
Desculpe, não tenho tempo para conversar.

entries.source:
Somehow I've got a whole bunch of
missions to deal with right now.
entries.translation:
Estou com um monte de missões
para resolver agora.

entries.source:
During the destruction of the Hidden
Leaf Village, my sensei was...
entries.translation:
Durante a destruição da Vila
da Folha, meu sensei...

entries.source:
Such an awful thing happened here when
we were out on a mission.
entries.translation:
Algo tão terrível aconteceu aqui
enquanto estávamos numa missão.

entries.source:
I don't even wanna think about what
would have happened to us if we had
stayed in the village...
entries.translation:
Nem quero pensar no que
teria acontecido se
tivéssemos ficado na vila...

entries.source:
Blast those Sound Village thugs... And
what they did to the Third Hokage...
entries.translation:
Malditos bandidos do Som...
O que fizeram ao Terceiro...

entries.source:
I heard the Hidden Sand ninja were being
used by the Hidden Sound Village.
entries.translation:
Soube que os ninjas da Areia
estavam sendo usados
pela Vila Oculta do Som.

entries.source:
But I'll never forgive those thugs for
what they did. Never...
entries.translation:
Mas nunca perdoarei aqueles
bandidos pelo que fizeram. Nunca...

entries.source:
I've never been in a battle like that
last one... My hands shook so hard I
could barely hang on to my kunai knife.
entries.translation:
Nunca tinha lutado numa batalha
assim... Minhas mãos tremiam tanto
que mal conseguia segurar a kunai.

entries.source:
Times may be tough, but we've got to
keep plugging away at missions to show
our village hasn't lost any power.
entries.translation:
Os tempos são difíceis, mas devemos
continuar as missões para mostrar
que a vila não perdeu sua força.

entries.source:
I heard that Ninja Academy teachers are
even doing missions now. I've never seen
anything like it in all my years.
entries.translation:
Até professores da Academia Ninja
estão fazendo missões agora.
Nunca vi nada igual na vida.

entries.source: So your sensei is gone too?

Yeah, he's so busy with missions right
now, so he told us to train on our own
for a while.
entries.translation:
É, ele está cheio de missões.
Mandou a gente treinar
sozinho por um tempo.

entries.source:
That's weird. Nothing like this has ever
happened before.
entries.translation:
Que estranho. Nunca
aconteceu nada assim.

entries.source:
I never imagined that the Hidden Sand
and Hidden Sound were both in on the
plot...
entries.translation:
Nunca imaginei que a Areia
e o Som estivessem
juntos nesse plano...

entries.source:
If I only could've found out sooner, the
Third Hokage would be...
entries.translation:
Se eu tivesse descoberto antes,
o Terceiro Hokage estaria...

entries.source:
And what a nerve the people of the
Hidden Sand Village had! I'll never
forgive them for betraying us.
entries.translation:
E que ousadia do pessoal da Areia!
Nunca vou perdoar
a traição deles.

entries.source:
The Honorable Grandson must have been
crushed to see the Hokage pass away. He
was his grandfather, after all.
entries.translation:
O honorável neto deve ter ficado
arrasado com a morte do Hokage.
Afinal, era seu avô.

entries.source:
Now's the time to do your best Honorable
Grandson! More than ever! It takes a
true ninja to overcome such sadness!
entries.translation:
Agora, mais do que nunca, dê o seu
melhor, honorável neto! Um verdadeiro
ninja supera até essa tristeza!

entries.source:
Konohamaru's grandpa died, you know. I'm
really sad about that.
entries.translation:
O avô do Konohamaru morreu.
Estou muito triste.

entries.source:
But... Konohamaru must be a lot sadder
than me. We should try to help him feel
better.
entries.translation:
Mas... O Konohamaru deve estar
muito pior. Temos que
ajudá-lo a se animar.

entries.source:
Konohamaru looks... really lonely.
I wanna cheer him up somehow.
entries.translation:
Konohamaru parece... muito sozinho.
Quero animá-lo de algum jeito.

entries.source:
Everyone's been really downhearted
ever since the Third Hokage died.
entries.translation:
Todos estão muito abatidos
desde a morte do Terceiro Hokage.

entries.source:
But I think it's times like these we
really need to cheer up, don't you?
entries.translation:
Mas é nessas horas que
mais precisamos de ânimo, né?

entries.source:
Maybe I'll forget about business and take
the day off. Everyone needs to kick back
every now and then, right?
entries.translation:
Talvez eu esqueça os negócios
e tire uma folga. Todos precisam
descansar de vez em quando, né?

entries.source:
That settles it, then I'll... Hmm? What
should I do though...
entries.translation:
Está decidido, vou... Hmm?
Mas o que vou fazer...?

entries.source:
The steel-plated vest to protect you from
even the most horrendous attacks!!!
entries.translation:
Um colete revestido de aço
para proteger você até dos
ataques mais terríveis!!!

entries.source:
I haven't sold any of these suckers, as
usual... *sigh*Hahahaha... *sigh*...
entries.translation:
Como sempre, não vendi nenhum...
*Suspiro* Hahaha... *Suspiro*...

entries.source:
Did you hear the news? Rumor has it that
only one person passed the Chunin Exam
this time.
entries.translation:
Soube da novidade? Dizem que
só uma pessoa passou
no Exame Chunin desta vez.

entries.source:
Who do you think it was? It must have
been that “Sasuke,” don't you think?
Don't you think!?
entries.translation:
Quem será que foi? Deve ter
sido aquele Sasuke,
não acha? Não acha!?

entries.source:
Now that our Lord Hokage passed away,
who's supposed to protect our village?
entries.translation:
Agora que o Hokage morreu,
quem vai proteger nossa vila?

entries.source:
Personally, I want the legendary
kunoichi, Lady Tsunade, to take over.
But no one knows where she is.
entries.translation:
Eu queria que a lendária kunoichi,
a senhora Tsunade, assumisse.
Mas ninguém sabe onde ela está.

entries.source: Hmm... Where was that shop again...?
entries.translation: Hmm... Onde era aquela loja mesmo...?

entries.source: Heehee! You're so full of energy.

The Leaf Village sure has a lot
of people in it.
entries.translation:
A Vila da Folha tem
muita gente mesmo.

entries.source:
What kinda game should I play
today?
I gotta get home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Preciso ir para casa fazer a lição.

entries.source:
I wanna be a ninja too,
an' do lots an' lots of missions!
entries.translation:
Quero ser ninja também
e fazer muitas missões!

entries.source:
My dad's coming back from his
mission real soon! Heheh,
I can't wait!
entries.translation:
Meu pai logo vai voltar
da missão! Hehe,
mal posso esperar!

entries.source:
I want to be a ninja, too...
Then I could protect my little sister!
entries.translation:
Quero ser ninja também...
Assim protegerei minha irmãzinha!

entries.source:
I saw the Hokage's house...
It's HUGE!
entries.translation:
Vi a casa do Hokage...
É ENORME!

entries.source:
The village sure is larger than
it used to be.
entries.translation:
A vila está bem maior
do que era antes.

entries.source:
I deeply respect the current Hokage,
but the First and Second Hokages
were simply amazing.
entries.translation:
Respeito muito o Hokage atual,
mas o Primeiro e o Segundo
eram incríveis.

entries.source:
I should go home.
My son's probably worried.
entries.translation:
É melhor eu ir para casa.
Meu filho deve estar preocupado.

entries.source:
Hmm...?
Now where was I again...?

My goodness, if you aren't a
rambunctious little ninja.
entries.translation:
Nossa, que ninjinha
agitado você é.

entries.source:
Hm? Sorry, can it wait?
I'm really busy right now.
entries.translation:
Hm? Desculpe, pode esperar?
Estou muito ocupado agora.

entries.source:
When is my no-good loafer of a
husband going to be home!?
entries.translation:
Quando meu marido imprestável
vai voltar para casa!?

entries.source: I wonder what I should eat today.
entries.translation: O que será que vou comer hoje?

entries.source:
Finally, I get a break!
It's time for fun!
entries.translation:
Finalmente, uma folga!
Hora de me divertir!

entries.source:
Heheh, you're the new kid, ain'tcha?
Good luck!
entries.translation:
Hehe, você é o novato, né?
Boa sorte!

entries.source:
Hey! You keeping up the training?
Ninja must be ever diligent!
entries.translation:
Ei! Está treinando direito?
Um ninja deve se dedicar sempre!

entries.source:
My folks are always yelling at me to
make chunin already. You think I
haven't been trying!?
entries.translation:
Meus pais vivem cobrando que eu
vire chunin logo. Acham
que não estou tentando!?

entries.source:
My little brother wants to be a
ninja, too. For his sake, I can't
let myself lose.
entries.translation:
Meu irmãozinho também quer ser ninja.
Por ele, não posso
me dar ao luxo de perder.

entries.source:
Uh... I ate too much Ichiraku Ramen... I
can't eat any more...
entries.translation:
Ah... Comi demais no Ichiraku Ramen...
Não aguento mais...

entries.source:
Let's see, where will my next
mission take me...? Careful
preparation is key.
entries.translation:
Vamos ver, para onde minha próxima
missão me levará...?
É essencial me preparar bem.

entries.source:
Rats! I can't believe I failed
my mission...
entries.translation:
Droga! Não acredito
que falhei na missão...

entries.source:
The Uchiha clan, the Hyuga clan...
Some real big names in the
latest crop of genin.
entries.translation:
O clã Uchiha, o clã Hyuga...
Há nomes importantes entre
os novos genin.

entries.source:
It's rare enough that I get some
time off... Think I'll take it easy.
entries.translation:
É tão raro eu ter uma folga...
Acho que vou descansar.

entries.source:
Sasuke... Naruto... Take care of Sasuke
for me...
entries.translation:
Sasuke... Naruto...
Cuide do Sasuke por mim...

entries.source:
I know that Sasuke will definitely come
back!
entries.translation:
Sei que o Sasuke
vai voltar com certeza!

entries.source:
We've still got a match to settle! So
I'm sure he'll be back!
entries.translation:
Ainda temos uma luta para resolver!
Por isso sei que ele voltará!

entries.source:
Hey there! Is it true that Lady Tsunade
has come back!?
entries.translation:
Ei! É verdade que a senhora
Tsunade voltou!?

entries.source:
I really admire Lady Tsunade. She's so
pretty and powerful... I would like to
become like her.
entries.translation:
Admiro muito a senhora Tsunade.
É tão bonita e poderosa...
Queria ser como ela.

entries.source:
No matter how hopeless, you must never
give up. The second you give up, it's
all over.
entries.translation:
Por mais difícil que pareça, nunca
desista. No instante em que
desistir, tudo acaba.

entries.source:
But if you stick it out, there's always
a way! It's up to you to blaze a trail
on that way! Do your best!!
entries.translation:
Se persistir, sempre haverá um jeito!
Cabe a você abrir esse caminho!
Dê o seu melhor!!

entries.source:
Anyway, have you heard? The next Hokage
is going to be female.
entries.translation:
Aliás, ficou sabendo?
O próximo Hokage será uma mulher.

entries.source:
Who is it? I guess it’ll be some pure
woman who loves flowers...?
entries.translation:
Quem será? Imagino uma mulher
delicada que adora flores...

entries.source:
I heard you're teaming up with Shikamaru
to go after Sasuke.
entries.translation:
Ouvi que vai atrás do Sasuke
com o Shikamaru.

entries.source:
Shikamaru's got a good head on his
shoulders. You should really take his
advice.
entries.translation:
Shikamaru é muito inteligente.
Você deve mesmo
ouvir os conselhos dele.

entries.source:
You seem awfully busy. Actually I'm busy
myself.
entries.translation:
Você parece bem ocupado.
Eu também estou.

entries.source:
I'm about to go on a mission with my
dad. Looks like it's gonna be a long
one, too...
entries.translation:
Vou sair numa missão com meu pai.
Parece que vai demorar
bastante, também...

entries.source:
Um... I heard Sasuke left the village,
but... Did... Did he really do that?
entries.translation:
É... Soube que o Sasuke deixou
a vila, mas... E-ele
fez isso mesmo?

entries.source:
Um... All I can offer is a little
encouragement... Um...Good luck...!
entries.translation:
É... Só posso oferecer
um incentivo...
B-boa sorte...!

entries.source:
Shikamaru's the only one who made it to
become a chunin. Certainly... That kid's
got brains, you know.
entries.translation:
Só o Shikamaru virou chunin.
É claro... Aquele garoto
é muito esperto.

entries.source:
To tell you the truth, I wanted to give
Shino a chance, too. That turmoil came
up before his match was on...
entries.translation:
Sinceramente, queria dar uma chance
ao Shino também. A confusão
começou antes da luta dele...

entries.source:
Two A-Ranks... Which means it'll take at
least two weeks before coming back.
entries.translation:
Duas missões de nível A...
Vou levar pelo menos
duas semanas para voltar.

entries.source:
I'll have to take a lot of Sweet Red
Bean Soup with me. I can't live without
it.
entries.translation:
Terei que levar muita sopa doce
de feijão vermelho.
Não vivo sem ela.

entries.source:
We've got a major shortage of human
resources in the Hidden Leaf Village.
I'm prepping for another mission myself.
entries.translation:
Faltam muitos ninjas na Vila
da Folha. Já estou
preparando outra missão.

entries.source:
I'd rather go eat some ramen with you,
but that has to wait until next time.
entries.translation:
Preferia ir comer lámen com você,
mas vai ficar para a próxima.

entries.source:
You seem really busy lately. I mean, we
don't ever play together anymore.
entries.translation:
Você está muito ocupado ultimamente.
Nem brincamos mais juntos.

entries.source:
But you're still the coolest person I
know! You're the one I wanna become
like!
entries.translation:
Mas ainda é a pessoa mais legal
que conheço! Quero
ser igual a você!

entries.source: So Sasuke is heading for Orochimaru...
entries.translation:
Então o Sasuke está indo
atrás do Orochimaru...

entries.source:
History repeats itself yet again, I
suppose...
entries.translation:
A história se repete
mais uma vez...

entries.source:
I haven't been to this village in years.
It's good to see not much has changed.
entries.translation:
Faz anos que não venho à vila.
Que bom ver que mudou pouco.

entries.source:
But that doesn't mean all is well. We've
got to hurry up and save Sasuke Uchiha.
entries.translation:
Mas isso não significa que
está tudo bem. Precisamos
salvar Sasuke Uchiha logo.

entries.source:
Naruto, you've just returned to the
village yet there's a lot to do now. I
want you to do your best.
entries.translation:
Naruto, você acabou de voltar,
mas já tem muito a fazer.
Quero que dê o seu melhor.

entries.source:
You were able to convince even that
stubborn Tsunade to come back, and I'm
sure you can do the same for Sasuke...
entries.translation:
Você convenceu até a teimosa
da Tsunade a voltar. Sei
que fará o mesmo pelo Sasuke...

entries.source:
I heard!? You had a big fight with The
Fifth Hokage.
entries.translation:
Fiquei sabendo! Você teve uma
grande briga com a Quinta Hokage.

entries.source:
Hey, guess what! I heard a new Hokage is
determined!
entries.translation:
Ei, soube que já escolheram
o novo Hokage!

entries.source:
I heard it's someone young and strong.
I'm dying to find out who it is!
entries.translation:
Dizem que é alguém jovem e forte.
Estou louco para saber quem é!

entries.source:
Huh, I'm sure it was around here
somewhere... Where is it?
entries.translation:
Hã, tenho certeza de que
era por aqui... Cadê?

entries.source:
I'm just trying to find my friend's
house... All these buildings go in and
out and realy confuse me.
entries.translation:
Só estou tentando achar a casa
do meu amigo... Esse monte
de prédios me deixa confuso.

entries.source:
I heard the next Hokage is a woman
in her fifties. I wonder what she's like...
entries.translation:
Soube que a próxima Hokage tem
uns cinquenta anos. Como será ela...?

entries.source:
Make-Out Paradise is gonna be made into
a movie. And... Oops I bet you have no
idea what I'm talking about.
entries.translation:
Paraíso da Pegação vai virar filme.
E... Ops, aposto que nem
sabe do que estou falando.

entries.source:
It's a regular cult classic. Go check it
out when you get a little older.
entries.translation:
É um clássico cult. Vá conferir
quando ficar mais velho.

entries.source:
So that wild woman came back. She's sure
to liven up this village even more.
entries.translation:
Então aquela mulher feroz voltou.
Vai animar ainda mais esta vila.

entries.source:
The Village ninja are moving around so
busily. Maybe it's because of that
turmoil.
entries.translation:
Os ninjas da vila estão tão
ocupados. Talvez seja
por causa da confusão.

entries.source:
They could've just asked me for help if
they were short-handed.
entries.translation:
Se estavam sem gente,
era só pedir minha ajuda.

entries.source:
The Third Hokage trained Jiraiya,
Tsunade, and Orochimaru to be great.
entries.translation:
O Terceiro Hokage treinou Jiraiya,
Tsunade e Orochimaru
para serem grandes ninjas.

entries.source:
But Orochimaru betrayed the others and
became their enemy... That must've been
tough on the Third Hokage...
entries.translation:
Mas Orochimaru traiu os outros
e se tornou inimigo... Deve ter
sido difícil para o Terceiro...

entries.source:
I was out enjoying a nice walk at night,
and I heard a voice coming from
somewhere.
entries.translation:
Eu passeava à noite quando
ouvi uma voz
vindo de algum lugar.

entries.source:
It was like calling out in
desperation... Saying things like "don't
go" and such I recall...
entries.translation:
Parecia um grito de desespero...
Dizia coisas como “não vá”,
pelo que me lembro...

entries.source:
The new Hokage's a woman... And she
doesn't look very strong.
entries.translation:
A nova Hokage é uma mulher...
E nem parece tão forte.

entries.source:
In fact, I'll bet I could beat her
myself! I'll give it a shot later.
entries.translation:
Aposto que até eu conseguiria
derrotá-la! Depois vou tentar.

entries.source:
Hinata gave me some medicine when I fell
down and hurt myself.
entries.translation:
Hinata me deu remédio
quando caí e me machuquei.

entries.source:
Hinata's super nice, you know. I really
like her a lot.
entries.translation:
Hinata é muito gentil.
Gosto muito dela.

entries.source:
Konohamaru must be the best hide-and-
seek player in the whole world. I can't
ever find him.
entries.translation:
Konohamaru deve ser o melhor
do mundo no esconde-esconde.
Nunca consigo encontrá-lo.

entries.source: You should play too. He's really good.
entries.translation:
Você devia brincar também.
Ele é muito bom.

entries.source:
My dad's always going on missions these
days... He's really busy.
entries.translation:
Meu pai vive saindo em missões
agora... Está muito ocupado.

entries.source:
Actually, I’d like you to watch my
shuriken training... But I can’t force
you...
entries.translation:
Eu queria que você visse meu
treino de shuriken...
Mas não posso obrigá-lo...

entries.source:
I just saw a beautiful woman passing
through. Sure would like to know who it
is.
entries.translation:
Acabei de ver uma mulher linda
passando por aqui.
Queria saber quem é.

entries.source:
The jonin were bowing to her. It must've
really been someone of high status.
entries.translation:
Os jonin se curvavam para ela.
Deve ser alguém
muito importante.

entries.source:
It seems like we have fewer ninja in our
village now. And I don't think I'm
imagining things.
entries.translation:
Parece que há menos ninjas
na vila agora. Acho
que não é só impressão.

entries.source:
What if something bad happens again?
Who's going to protect us!?
entries.translation:
E se acontecer algo ruim de novo?
Quem vai nos proteger!?

entries.source:
I was just chatting with Anko a little
bit ago. That girl sure has a sweet
tooth...
entries.translation:
Conversei com a Anko agora há pouco.
Aquela menina adora doces...

entries.source:
She was eating so much sugar it made me
sick to my stomach. How does she keep
that tiny figure?
entries.translation:
Ela comia tanto açúcar que até
me embrulhou o estômago.
Como consegue ficar tão magra?

entries.source:
Lady Tsunade's been chosen as the Fifth
Hokage, huh... Well that's certainly
good news.
entries.translation:
A senhora Tsunade foi escolhida
como Quinta Hokage...
Que ótima notícia.

entries.source:
That Lady Tsunade's got a quick wit and
a good head on her shoulders. She'll be
perfect for the job.
entries.translation:
A senhora Tsunade é esperta
e sensata. Será
perfeita para o cargo.

entries.source:
That old Guy is really funny, isn't he?
Always yelling like "I'm hot-blooded!"
entries.translation:
Aquele velho Guy é engraçado, né?
Vive gritando: “Tenho sangue quente!”

entries.source:
Just don't call him "old." He hates
that, and says he's still young!
entries.translation:
Só não o chame de velho.
Ele odeia isso e diz
que ainda é jovem!

entries.source: Hey, how come Sakura looks so depressed?
entries.translation: Ei, por que a Sakura parece tão triste?

entries.source:
My mom says I can play outside now that
it's safe.
entries.translation:
Minha mãe disse que posso brincar
lá fora, agora que está seguro.

entries.source:
What was so dangerous all this time,
anyway? I have no idea.
entries.translation:
Mas o que estava tão perigoso
esse tempo todo? Não faço ideia.

entries.source:
Hey. I haven't seen Sasuke around
lately. Did something happen?
entries.translation:
Ei. Não vejo o Sasuke por aqui
ultimamente. Aconteceu algo?

entries.source:
I even wrote a letter to Sasuke. How
frustrating...
entries.translation:
Até escrevi uma carta para ele.
Que frustração...

entries.source:
I haven't seen Lady Tsunade for quite
some time.
entries.translation:
Faz muito tempo que
não vejo a senhora Tsunade.

entries.source:
She's a very strict person, but that
should settle down the village.
entries.translation:
Ela é muito rígida, mas isso
deve pôr a vila em ordem.

entries.source: Whoa there. Why are you in such a rush?
entries.translation: Calma aí. Por que tanta pressa?

entries.source:
You might end up blacking out if you
overdo it. So calm down a little, okay?
entries.translation:
Pode acabar desmaiando se exagerar.
Então se acalme um pouco, certo?

entries.source:
A lot of clans live in this village, and
there used to be the Uchiha Clan a
little while ago.
entries.translation:
Muitos clãs vivem nesta vila.
Até pouco tempo,
havia também o clã Uchiha.

entries.source:
But... that boy Sasuke is all alone now.
Sadly everyone else has died...
entries.translation:
Mas... Aquele Sasuke está sozinho
agora. Infelizmente,
todos os outros morreram...

entries.source:
My husband's been in such a good mood
since Lady Tsunade came back.
entries.translation:
Meu marido está tão animado
desde que a senhora Tsunade voltou.

entries.source:
He says she's the "prettiest and strongest
the world's got to offer." That man is just
impossible sometimes...
entries.translation:
Diz que ela é a mais bonita
e forte do mundo. Aquele homem
é impossível às vezes...

entries.source:
I heard there used to be a trio of
amazing ninja in this village called the
"Sannin."
entries.translation:
Soube que havia três ninjas
incríveis nesta vila,
os Sannin.

entries.source:
*sigh* I wish they were still here, then
they could train me.
entries.translation:
*Suspiro* Queria que estivessem aqui.
Assim, poderiam me treinar.

entries.source:
Isn't Shikamaru the only one who made
chunin at the exam this time?
entries.translation:
Não foi só o Shikamaru que virou
chunin no exame desta vez?

entries.source:
Hyuga and Hidden Sand don't have much to
offer. Maybe I've got a chance!
entries.translation:
Os Hyuga e a Areia nem são
tudo isso. Talvez
eu tenha uma chance!

entries.source:
I'll train extra hard in honor of my
sensei who died in the destruction of
the Hidden Leaf Village.
entries.translation:
Vou treinar ainda mais em homenagem
ao meu sensei, que morreu
na destruição da Vila da Folha.

entries.source:
I'll surprise you and become a great
ninja, sensei!
entries.translation:
Vou surpreender você e me tornar
um grande ninja, sensei!

entries.source:
I'm finally back from the mission. That
was a hard one...
entries.translation:
Finalmente voltei da missão.
Essa foi difícil...

entries.source:
I had to carry a 40-pound crate to the
Land of Water. My legs and back feel
like mush...
entries.translation:
Tive que levar uma caixa de 18 quilos
até o País da Água. Minhas
pernas e costas estão acabadas...

entries.source:
Looks like Lady Tsunade's gonna be the
Fifth Hokage.
entries.translation:
Parece que a senhora Tsunade
será a Quinta Hokage.

entries.source:
I thought Master Jiraiya would end up
being the next one. Guess I was wrong.
entries.translation:
Achei que o mestre Jiraiya
seria o próximo. Me enganei.

entries.source:
I heard that the Fourth Hokage created
the jutsu called Rasengan.
entries.translation:
Soube que o Quarto Hokage criou
o jutsu chamado Rasengan.

entries.source:
But it takes an incredible amount of
time to master. I tried once and
couldn't grasp it.
entries.translation:
Mas leva muito tempo para dominar.
Tentei uma vez e
não consegui entender.

entries.source:
Did you hear? We've formed an alliance
with the Hidden Sand Village! They
won't betray us again, will they?
entries.translation:
Ficou sabendo? Formamos uma aliança
com a Areia! Eles não vão
nos trair de novo, né?

entries.source:
Now that Lady Tsunade and Shizune are
back, our medical department will become
much more solid!
entries.translation:
Com a volta da senhora Tsunade
e da Shizune, nosso setor
médico ficará muito mais forte!

entries.source:
Those two are specialists, you know. I'm
sure glad they're back.
entries.translation:
As duas são especialistas.
Que bom que voltaram.

entries.source:
Huh... The other day I saw a young boy
leaving the village at night.
entries.translation:
Hã... Outro dia vi um garoto
saindo da vila à noite.

entries.source:
Oh Grandpa. Are you sure you weren't
dreaming?
entries.translation:
Ah, vovô. Tem certeza
de que não estava sonhando?

entries.source:
Positive. I know a dream from reality,
and this really happened. Saw it with my
own eyes.
entries.translation:
Absoluta. Sei distinguir sonho
e realidade. Aconteceu
mesmo. Vi com meus olhos.

entries.source:
Sure you did. Well, we better get home
for dinner.
entries.translation:
Claro que viu. Bem, é melhor
irmos para casa jantar.

entries.source: Hey... You don't believe me, do you...
entries.translation:
Ei... Você não acredita
em mim, né...?

entries.source:
What kind of person is the new Hokage,
Dad?
entries.translation:
Como é a nova Hokage,
papai?

entries.source:
Well, I'm not too sure, but it seems
like someone awful strong, and awful
scary.
entries.translation:
Bem, não sei direito,
mas parece ser muito forte
e muito assustadora.

entries.source: Wow, even more scary than mom?
entries.translation: Nossa, mais assustadora que a mamãe?

entries.source:
Hahaha! I'd say your mother's more
scary. She's always screamin' at you.
entries.translation:
Hahaha! Acho sua mãe
mais assustadora.
Ela vive gritando com você.

entries.source:
Is Lady Tsunade going to be the new
Hokage? We can feel safe trusting the
village to her.
entries.translation:
A senhora Tsunade será a nova Hokage?
Podemos confiar a vila
a ela e ficar tranquilos.

entries.source:
I heard you're the one who brought us
Lady Tsunade. I'm awfully thankful for
that, Naruto!
entries.translation:
Soube que foi você quem trouxe
a senhora Tsunade.
Muito obrigado, Naruto!

entries.source:
Konohamaru can use jutsu already. What
was it called again? Um...
entries.translation:
Konohamaru já consegue usar jutsu.
Como era o nome mesmo? É...

entries.source:
We've been playing ninja by ourselves
lately ‘cause you've been busy.
entries.translation:
Temos brincado de ninja sozinhos
porque você anda ocupado.

entries.source: You should play too sometimes, okay?

Lady Tsunade stopped by the other
day for some of our ramen.
entries.translation:
A senhora Tsunade passou aqui
outro dia para comer lámen.

entries.source:
She said it was comforting to see
that some tastes never change.
I'm so happy she liked it!
entries.translation:
Disse que era reconfortante ver
que alguns sabores não mudam.
Que bom que ela gostou!

entries.source:
I heard there's a new Hokage runnin' the
place now. It's easy to see how happy
everyone is.
entries.translation:
Soube que há uma nova Hokage
por aqui. Dá para ver
como todos estão felizes.

entries.source:
I better take advantage of the mood! All
right! Time to get down to business!
entries.translation:
Vou aproveitar o clima!
Certo! Hora dos negócios!

entries.source:
How about a smokeless smoke bomb? Freak
someone out with a real DUD! This
product's sure to be a hit!
entries.translation:
Que tal uma bomba de fumaça
sem fumaça? Surpreenda com uma
bomba FALSA! Será um sucesso!

entries.source:
At least... that's what I thought, but I
haven't even sold one yet.　No! What am I
doing wrong?!
entries.translation:
Pelo menos era o que eu achava,
mas não vendi nem uma!
Não! O que estou fazendo errado?!

entries.source:
The rookies this year really... stand out,
don't they? Even more than I do.
entries.translation:
Os novatos deste ano se destacam
mesmo, né? Até mais do que eu.

entries.source:
I heard Lady Tsunade came back to the
village!
entries.translation:
Soube que a senhora Tsunade
voltou à vila!

entries.source:
She must be at the Hokage's Mansion,
right!? I better head over there right
now!
entries.translation:
Ela deve estar na Mansão Hokage, né!?
É melhor eu ir lá agora!

entries.source: Hmm... Where was that shop again...?
entries.translation: Hmm... Onde era aquela loja mesmo...?

entries.source: Heehee! You're so full of energy.

The Leaf Village sure has a lot
of people in it.
entries.translation:
A Vila da Folha tem
muita gente mesmo.

entries.source:
What kinda game should I play
today?
I gotta get home and do my homework.
entries.translation: Preciso ir para casa fazer a lição.

entries.source:
I wanna be a ninja too,
an' do lots an' lots of missions!
entries.translation:
Quero ser ninja também
e fazer muitas missões!

entries.source:
My dad's coming back from his
mission real soon! Heheh,
I can't wait!
entries.translation:
Meu pai logo vai voltar
da missão! Hehe,
mal posso esperar!

entries.source:
I want to be a ninja, too...
Then I could protect my little sister!
entries.translation:
Quero ser ninja também...
Assim protegerei minha irmãzinha!

entries.source:
I saw the Hokage's house...
It's HUGE!
entries.translation:
Vi a casa do Hokage...
É ENORME!

entries.source:
The village sure is larger than
it used to be.
entries.translation:
A vila está bem maior
do que era antes.

entries.source:
I deeply respect the current Hokage,
but the First and Second Hokages
were simply amazing.
entries.translation:
Respeito muito o Hokage atual,
mas o Primeiro e o Segundo
eram incríveis.

entries.source:
I should go home.
My son's probably worried.
entries.translation:
É melhor eu ir para casa.
Meu filho deve estar preocupado.

entries.source:
Hmm...?
Now where was I again...?

My goodness, if you aren't a
rambunctious little ninja.
entries.translation:
Nossa, que ninjinha
agitado você é.

entries.source:
Hm? Sorry, can it wait?
I'm really busy right now.
entries.translation:
Hm? Desculpe, pode esperar?
Estou muito ocupado agora.

entries.source:
When is my no-good loafer of a
husband going to be home!?
entries.translation:
Quando meu marido imprestável
vai voltar para casa!?

entries.source: I wonder what I should eat today.
entries.translation: O que será que vou comer hoje?

entries.source:
Finally, I get a break!
It's time for fun!
entries.translation:
Finalmente, uma folga!
Hora de me divertir!

entries.source:
Heheh, you're the new kid, ain'tcha?
Good luck!
entries.translation:
Hehe, você é o novato, né?
Boa sorte!

entries.source:
Hey! You keeping up the training?
Ninja must be ever diligent!
entries.translation:
Ei! Está treinando direito?
Um ninja deve se dedicar sempre!

entries.source:
My folks are always yelling at me to
make chunin already. You think I
haven't been trying!?
entries.translation:
Meus pais vivem cobrando que eu
vire chunin logo. Acham
que não estou tentando!?

entries.source:
My little brother wants to be a
ninja, too. For his sake, I can't
let myself lose.
entries.translation:
Meu irmãozinho também quer ser ninja.
Por ele, não posso
me dar ao luxo de perder.

entries.source:
Uh... I ate too much Ichiraku Ramen... I
can't eat any more...
entries.translation:
Ah... Comi demais no Ichiraku Ramen...
Não aguento mais...

entries.source:
Let's see, where will my next
mission take me...? Careful
preparation is key.
entries.translation:
Vamos ver, para onde minha próxima
missão me levará...?
É essencial me preparar bem.

entries.source:
Rats! I can't believe I failed
my mission...
entries.translation:
Droga! Não acredito
que falhei na missão...

entries.source:
The Uchiha clan, the Hyuga clan...
Some real big names in the
latest crop of genin.
entries.translation:
O clã Uchiha, o clã Hyuga...
Há nomes importantes entre
os novos genin.

entries.source:
It's rare enough that I get some
time off... Think I'll take it easy.
entries.translation:
É tão raro eu ter uma folga...
Acho que vou descansar.

entries.source:
We are going to bring Sasuke back,
Naruto! I know we can do it!
entries.translation:
Vamos trazer o Sasuke de volta,
Naruto! Sei que conseguiremos!

entries.source:
That must've been a rough experience for
you. And, sorry for not being able to
make it in time...
entries.translation:
Deve ter sido muito difícil
para você. Desculpe
por não chegar a tempo...

entries.source:
I'm not gonna ask about your plans from
here on out. Just make sure not to do
anything you'll regret. Okay?
entries.translation:
Não vou perguntar sobre seus planos.
Só não faça nada de que
vá se arrepender, certo?

entries.source:
I never thought the Hidden Sound Village
had such a powerful master...
entries.translation:
Nunca pensei que a Vila Oculta
do Som tivesse um mestre
tão poderoso...

entries.source:
I, too, must get stronger... There's
still more to deal with...
entries.translation:
Também preciso ficar mais forte...
Ainda há muito pela frente...

entries.source:
I actually might've lost if Gaara of the
Sand hadn't shown up...
entries.translation:
Eu poderia ter perdido se
o Gaara da Areia não aparecesse...

entries.source:
Next time... I'll be the one rescuing
instead of being rescued!!
entries.translation:
Na próxima... Eu vou salvar
os outros, em vez de ser salvo!!

entries.source:
Lee and Neji were on that recent mission
behind my back, weren't they?!
entries.translation:
Lee e Neji foram naquela missão
sem me contar, né?!

entries.source:
Talk about rude! They should've taken me
along too!
entries.translation:
Que falta de consideração!
Deviam ter me levado também!

entries.source:
Urmm... So you couldn't bring Sasuke
back...
entries.translation:
Hmm... Então você não conseguiu
trazer o Sasuke de volta...

entries.source:
But you've still got a hopeful spark in
your eyes. I know I can count on you!!
entries.translation:
Mas ainda vejo esperança
nos seus olhos. Sei que
posso contar com você!!

entries.source:
The results of that last mission showed
you I've still got a lot to learn...
Sorry about that... Naruto...
entries.translation:
A última missão mostrou quanto
ainda preciso aprender...
Desculpe por isso, Naruto...

entries.source:
But don't worry. Next time I'll handle
it right.
entries.translation:
Mas não se preocupe.
Na próxima, farei direito.

entries.source:
That was too bad about Sasuke, but I'm
glad everyone's okay.
entries.translation:
Foi uma pena sobre o Sasuke,
mas que bom que todos estão bem.

entries.source:
We can still challenge again as long as
we're alive! So let's keep up our best,
Naruto!
entries.translation:
Enquanto estivermos vivos, podemos
tentar de novo! Então vamos
continuar nos esforçando, Naruto!

entries.source:
Stop being so negative, Naruto. I like
you much better as your stupid-happy old
self!
entries.translation:
Pare de ser tão negativo, Naruto.
Gosto mais de você
com aquele sorriso bobo de sempre!

entries.source:
Does fear of failure cause you to curl
up and turn tail, or does it motivate
you to set your mind on improving?
entries.translation:
O medo de falhar faz você
se encolher e fugir, ou
o motiva a melhorar?

entries.source:
I see you as the latter type. And it's
good that way.
entries.translation:
Vejo você como o segundo tipo.
E isso é bom.

entries.source:
Akamaru was hurt on that mission... I
wasn't good enough to help him...
entries.translation:
Akamaru se feriu naquela missão...
Não fui bom o bastante para ajudá-lo...

entries.source:
I can't let Akamaru down next time. I'll
train hard to become stronger and make
it up to him!
entries.translation:
Não posso decepcionar Akamaru de novo.
Vou treinar para ficar mais forte
e compensar isso!

entries.source:
Kiba told me that the last recapture
mission was pretty amazing...
entries.translation:
Kiba disse que a última missão
de resgate foi incrível...

entries.source: Why didn't you take me...? Never mind...
entries.translation: Por que não me levaram...? Deixa...

entries.source:
Naruto...? I heard you got hurt really
bad...
entries.translation:
Naruto...? Soube que você
se feriu muito...

entries.source:
But... you seem okay now, right? What a
relief...
entries.translation:
Mas... Parece bem agora, né?
Que alívio...

entries.source:
Shikamaru did very well with a platoon
consisting of only genin.
entries.translation:
Shikamaru foi muito bem com
um pelotão formado só por genin.

entries.source:
And I'm glad you made it back safely
too. That's what's most important.
entries.translation:
E que bom que você voltou
em segurança. É o mais importante.

entries.source:
I don't care what happens to that Uchiha
kid.
entries.translation:
Não me importa o que aconteça
com aquele garoto Uchiha.

entries.source:
But I'll never forgive Orochimaru for
how he did that... Someday I'll put an
end to his madness... with my own hands.
entries.translation:
Mas nunca perdoarei o Orochimaru
pelo que fez... Um dia vou pôr fim
à loucura dele com minhas mãos.

entries.source:
I heard about Sasuke...
How you didn't quite make it...
entries.translation:
Soube do Sasuke...
Que você não conseguiu...

entries.source:
But you're not the type to give up!
You've still got my support, Naruto!
entries.translation:
Mas você não é de desistir!
Continuo torcendo por você, Naruto!

entries.source:
I better train hard every day if I wanna
get strong like you!
entries.translation:
Preciso treinar todos os dias
para ficar forte como você!

entries.source:
My training is hard so go enjoy yourself
while you can.
entries.translation:
Meu treino é duro. Vá se divertir
enquanto ainda pode.

entries.source:
I'll be on you like glue during
training, so I got to go out and do a
little more research than usual!
entries.translation:
Vou ficar em cima de você
durante o treino. Por isso
preciso pesquisar mais antes!

entries.source:
Sakura signed up to be one of my pupils
just now.
entries.translation:
Sakura acabou de se tornar
minha aluna.

entries.source:
Heheh, I wonder who'll end up improving
the most. Sounds like a competition, eh
Naruto?
entries.translation:
Hehe, quem será que vai evoluir
mais? Parece uma competição,
hein, Naruto?

entries.source:
I heard you're leaving to train with
Jiraiya. We'll kind of miss you around
here.
entries.translation:
Soube que vai treinar com Jiraiya.
Sentiremos sua falta por aqui.

entries.source:
Please promise you'll come back safely,
Naruto. We'll all be waiting for you.
entries.translation:
Prometa voltar em segurança,
Naruto. Estaremos esperando.

entries.source:
That Sound Ninja, Kimimaro... He was no
different than you... Naruto...
entries.translation:
Aquele ninja do Som, Kimimaro...
Não era diferente de você, Naruto...

entries.source:
Fight for those who are important...
That was the only will...
entries.translation:
Lutar por quem é importante...
Era sua única vontade...

entries.source:
I never thought I'd be able to return to
the Leaf Village like this.
entries.translation:
Nunca imaginei que poderia
voltar à Vila da Folha assim.

entries.source:
Sorry about that whole attacking-your-
village thing. But you can relax now,
we're not going to betray you again.
entries.translation:
Desculpe por termos atacado sua vila.
Mas pode relaxar agora,
não vamos trair vocês de novo.

entries.source:
I admit that we were wrong about the
Destruction of the Hidden Leaf
Village...
entries.translation:
Admito que erramos
na destruição da Vila da Folha...

entries.source:
But we were only following orders... It
was nothing personal...
entries.translation:
Mas só seguíamos ordens...
Não era nada pessoal...

entries.source:
You’re a much better ninja than before.
Okay, keep on trying your best!
entries.translation:
Você é um ninja muito melhor agora.
Certo, continue se esforçando!

entries.source:
I finally got to see the Fifth Hokage!
Talk about a beauty queen!
entries.translation:
Finalmente vi a Quinta Hokage!
Que mulher linda!

entries.source:
I always thought the Hokage had to be
some old guy, but boy was I way off!
entries.translation:
Sempre achei que o Hokage tinha
que ser um velhote.
Como eu estava enganado!

entries.source:
What a relaxing day. It's nice to have
days like this every once in a while.
entries.translation:
Que dia tranquilo. É bom
ter dias assim de vez em quando.

entries.source:
Hey, something about your eyes... They
look different today...
entries.translation:
Ei, tem algo no seu olhar...
Está diferente hoje...

entries.source:
Are you starting something new? Whatever
it is, you've got my support.
entries.translation:
Vai começar algo novo? Seja
o que for, tem meu apoio.

entries.source:
I went to Ichiraku and saw a bunch of
Ninja Academy students enjoying ramen
with their sensei.
entries.translation:
Fui ao Ichiraku e vi alunos
da Academia Ninja comendo
lámen com seu sensei.

entries.source:
It was nice to see how much those
students admired their sensei.
entries.translation:
Foi bom ver o quanto aqueles
alunos admiravam o sensei.

entries.source:
A nice breeze always takes away the
unpleasant things... I can feel the
kindness.
entries.translation:
Uma boa brisa leva embora
as coisas ruins...
Sinto essa gentileza.

entries.source:
I saw a Hidden Sand ninja just a little
while ago, and it seems that our
alliance with them is still strong.
entries.translation:
Vi um ninja da Areia há pouco.
Parece que nossa aliança
continua firme.

entries.source:
I hope we can maintain good relations
with them, with no more betrayal.
entries.translation:
Espero que mantenhamos boas
relações, sem novas traições.

entries.source:
It doesn't look like they'll be holding
a rematch for the Chunin Exam.
entries.translation:
Parece que não haverá
revanche do Exame Chunin.

entries.source:
Urmm... That's a shame. I was looking
forward to it but it seems it can't be
helped...
entries.translation:
Hmm... Que pena. Eu estava
ansioso, mas parece
que não tem jeito...

entries.source:
I learned a lot about the roads in this
village from wandering around.
entries.translation:
Aprendi muito sobre as ruas
da vila andando por aí.

entries.source:
You can discover strange new things in
places new to you. This is always fun
even at my age.
entries.translation:
Em lugares novos, descobrimos
coisas curiosas. É divertido
até na minha idade.

entries.source: The Fifth Hokage is super powerful!
entries.translation: A Quinta Hokage é muito forte!

entries.source:
She flicked some white-haired guy in the
forehead the other day and sent him
flying!
entries.translation:
Outro dia ela deu um peteleco
num sujeito de cabelo branco
e mandou ele voando!

entries.source:
I'll be going off to the Ninja Academy
soon. I'm really nervous about it, but
also excited.
entries.translation:
Logo vou para a Academia Ninja.
Estou nervoso,
mas também animado.

entries.source:
I'll learn a whole bunch of jutsu and
train to be an awesome ninja!
entries.translation:
Vou aprender muitos jutsus
e treinar para ser um ninja incrível!

entries.source:
My mom said she was a fierce ninja a
long time ago.
entries.translation:
Minha mãe disse que era
uma ninja feroz há muito tempo.

entries.source:
I don't know if she's telling the truth,
but it might be true. Because she can
get pretty scary when she's mad...
entries.translation:
Não sei se é verdade, mas
pode ser. Ela fica bem
assustadora quando está brava...

entries.source:
Yikes. I can't keep up with my studies
at school...
entries.translation:
Ai. Não consigo acompanhar
os estudos na escola...

entries.source:
At this rate I could lose to the
legendary, biggest loser in school! I
better hit the books!
entries.translation:
Assim vou perder até para o maior
fracassado da história da escola!
Preciso estudar!

entries.source:
I just saw a Sand Ninja over there, but
we're on good terms with them now,
right?
entries.translation:
Vi um ninja da Areia ali,
mas estamos de bem
com eles agora, né?

entries.source:
Whatever happened in the past, it's
always comforting to know we can forgive
and move on.
entries.translation:
Não importa o passado, é bom
saber que podemos perdoar
e seguir em frente.

entries.source:
Is it true the Fifth Hokage's a
gambling addict? I heard they call
her the "Legendary Sitting Duck."
entries.translation:
É verdade que a Quinta Hokage
é viciada em apostas? Dizem
que é a “Perdedora Lendária”.

entries.source:
That's just silly, right? I mean the
Fifth Hokage, a poor gambler?
entries.translation:
Deve ser bobagem, né?
A Quinta Hokage perder nas apostas?

entries.source:
Maybe I'm just imagining things, but
don't you think the Hyuga Clan has
softened up a bit?
entries.translation:
Talvez seja impressão, mas o clã
Hyuga não está um pouco
menos rígido?

entries.source:
I used to think they were so stern, but
I've seen them smiling recently.
entries.translation:
Eu os achava tão sérios,
mas tenho visto sorrisos ultimamente.

entries.source:
Yamanaka Flower shop always keeps
lovely fresh flowers out in front of
their shop. That really brightens me up.
entries.translation:
A Floricultura Yamanaka sempre
expõe flores lindas e frescas.
Isso alegra meu dia.

entries.source:
Maybe I'll get some flowers to decorate
my room with. That would brighten up the
mood.
entries.translation:
Talvez eu compre flores
para meu quarto.
Isso alegraria o ambiente.

entries.source:
I always see a little frog hopping
around, but all it ever does is play
tricks on people.
entries.translation:
Sempre vejo um sapinho pulando
por aí, mas ele só
faz travessuras.

entries.source:
But it always says funny stuff when I
talk to him. I love that frog.
entries.translation:
Mas, quando falo com ele,
só diz coisas engraçadas.
Adoro aquele sapo.

entries.source:
I will join the Ninja Academy to become
a medical ninja!
entries.translation:
Vou entrar na Academia Ninja
para ser uma ninja médica!

entries.source:
It won't be easy, but I'll work hard and
make myself useful!
entries.translation:
